<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0, maximum-scale=1.0, user-scalable=no">
<title>TMGame - User Panel</title>
<style>
*{margin:0;padding:0;box-sizing:border-box;-webkit-tap-highlight-color:transparent}
body{font-family:-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI",Roboto,Arial,sans-serif;background:#f1f5f9;color:#0f172a;min-height:100vh;padding-bottom:calc(88px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom))}
button,input,select,textarea{font-family:inherit}
button{border:0;cursor:pointer;transition:transform .12s ease,opacity .12s ease}
button:active{transform:scale(.96);opacity:.88}
input,select,textarea{outline:none}
.hidden{display:none!important}

/* AUTH */
.auth-page{min-height:calc(100vh - 88px - env(safe-area-inset-bottom));display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:22px;background:linear-gradient(160deg,#f8fafc,#e0e7ff)}
.auth-box{width:100%;max-width:420px;background:#fff;border-radius:28px;padding:30px 24px;box-shadow:0 20px 50px rgba(0,0,0,.08)}
.logo{font-size:30px;font-weight:900}
.logo span{color:#4f46e5}
.auth-title{font-size:24px;margin-top:26px;margin-bottom:6px;font-weight:800}
.auth-sub{color:#64748b;margin-bottom:22px;font-size:14px}
.field{margin-bottom:14px}
.field label{display:block;font-size:13px;font-weight:700;margin-bottom:6px;color:#334155}
.field input{width:100%;height:52px;border:1px solid #cbd5e1;border-radius:14px;padding:0 16px;font-size:15px}
.primary-btn{width:100%;height:52px;border-radius:14px;background:#4f46e5;color:#fff;font-size:16px;font-weight:800;margin-top:6px}
.auth-switch{text-align:center;margin-top:18px;color:#64748b;font-size:14px}
.auth-switch button{background:none;color:#4f46e5;font-weight:800}

/* HEADER */
.app-header{height:70px;background:#fff;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;padding:0 18px;position:sticky;top:0;z-index:30;box-shadow:0 2px 12px rgba(0,0,0,.05)}
.header-logo{font-size:22px;font-weight:900}
.header-user{color:#64748b;font-size:14px;max-width:130px;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}

/* MAIN */
.main{max-width:640px;margin:0 auto;padding:16px}

/* PAGES */
.page{display:none}
.page.active{display:block}

/* CARDS */
.card{background:#fff;border-radius:22px;padding:20px;margin-bottom:16px;box-shadow:0 4px 18px rgba(0,0,0,.04)}
.section-title{font-size:20px;font-weight:800;margin-bottom:14px}

/* WALLET */
.wallet-card{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#4f46e5,#6366f1);color:#fff;border-radius:24px;padding:22px;margin-bottom:18px}
.wallet-label{opacity:.85;font-size:14px}
.wallet-balance{font-size:32px;font-weight:900;margin:6px 0 18px}
.wallet-actions{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:10px}
.wallet-actions button{height:46px;border-radius:14px;font-size:14px;font-weight:800}
.deposit-btn{background:#fff;color:#4f46e5}
.withdraw-btn{background:rgba(255,255,255,.18);color:#fff;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.3)}

/* TOURNAMENT */
.tournament-card{background:#fff;border-radius:20px;overflow:hidden;margin-bottom:16px;box-shadow:0 4px 16px rgba(0,0,0,.05)}
.tournament-banner{width:100%;aspect-ratio:16/9;object-fit:cover;background:#e2e8f0;display:block}
.tournament-body{padding:16px}
.tournament-name{font-size:17px;font-weight:800}
.badge{padding:5px 10px;border-radius:20px;font-size:11px;font-weight:800}
.badge-free{background:#dcfce7;color:#166534}
.badge-paid{background:#ffedd5;color:#9a3412}
.info-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:8px;margin:12px 0}
.info-box{background:#f8fafc;border-radius:12px;padding:10px}
.info-label{font-size:11px;color:#64748b;margin-bottom:2px}
.info-value{font-size:13px;font-weight:700}
.join-btn{width:100%;height:46px;border-radius:13px;background:#4f46e5;color:#fff;font-weight:800;font-size:14px}
.join-btn.disabled{background:#e2e8f0;color:#94a3b8}

/* SEAT GRID */
.seat-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(5,1fr);gap:8px;margin:16px 0}
.seat{height:42px;border-radius:10px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-weight:800;font-size:14px;background:#f1f5f9;color:#334155;border:2px solid transparent}
.seat.available{background:#f1f5f9;cursor:pointer}
.seat.available:active{background:#e0e7ff}
.seat.selected{background:#4f46e5;color:#fff;border-color:#4338ca}
.seat.taken{background:#fecaca;color:#991b1b;cursor:not-allowed;opacity:.7}
.seat.mine{background:#bbf7d0;color:#166534;border-color:#16a34a}

/* FILTER */
.filter-row{display:flex;gap:8px;overflow-x:auto;padding-bottom:8px;margin-bottom:12px}
.filter-row::-webkit-scrollbar{display:none}
.filter{white-space:nowrap;padding:9px 14px;border-radius:20px;background:#fff;color:#64748b;font-weight:700;font-size:13px;border:1px solid #e2e8f0}
.filter.active{background:#4f46e5;color:#fff;border-color:#4f46e5}

/* FORMS */
.form-input{width:100%;height:50px;border:1px solid #cbd5e1;border-radius:14px;padding:0 15px;font-size:15px;background:#fff;margin-bottom:12px}
.form-btn{width:100%;height:50px;border-radius:14px;background:#4f46e5;color:#fff;font-size:15px;font-weight:800}
.form-btn:disabled{opacity:.55;cursor:not-allowed}

/* NOTICE */
.notice{padding:12px 14px;background:#eef2ff;color:#4338ca;border-radius:13px;font-size:13px;margin-bottom:12px}
.warning{padding:12px 14px;background:#fef3c7;color:#92400e;border-radius:13px;font-size:13px;margin-bottom:12px}
.block-notice{padding:14px;background:#fef2f2;color:#b91c1c;border:1px solid #fecaca;border-radius:14px;font-size:13px;line-height:1.5;margin-bottom:14px}

/* HISTORY */
.history-item{padding:14px 0;border-top:1px solid #e2e8f0}
.history-item:first-child{border-top:0}
.history-line{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;margin-bottom:6px}
.history-label{color:#64748b;font-size:13px}
.history-value{font-weight:700;text-align:right;word-break:break-word;font-size:13px}
.status{display:inline-block;padding:4px 10px;border-radius:20px;font-size:11px;font-weight:700}
.status-pending{background:#fef3c7;color:#92400e}
.status-approved,.status-paid{background:#dcfce7;color:#166534}
.status-rejected{background:#fee2e2;color:#991b1b}

/* MATCH / MY TOURNAMENTS */
.match-card{background:#fff;border-radius:18px;padding:16px;margin-bottom:14px;box-shadow:0 3px 12px rgba(0,0,0,.04)}
.match-title{font-size:16px;font-weight:800;margin-bottom:10px}
.room-box{margin-top:12px;padding:14px;border-radius:14px;background:#eef2ff}
.prize-card{border-radius:16px;padding:16px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#fefce8,#fff);border:1px solid #fde68a;margin-top:12px}
.prize-amount{font-size:26px;font-weight:900;margin:4px 0}

/* PROFILE */
.profile-avatar{width:72px;height:72px;border-radius:50%;background:#4f46e5;color:#fff;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:28px;font-weight:900;margin-bottom:14px}
.profile-row{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:16px;padding:13px 0;border-bottom:1px solid #e2e8f0}
.profile-row:last-child{border-bottom:0}
.profile-label{color:#64748b;font-size:14px}
.profile-value{font-weight:700;text-align:right;word-break:break-word;font-size:14px}


/* GAME CATEGORY SLIDER */
.cat-slider{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:12px;padding:4px 2px 14px}
/* no-match category tone */
.cat-card.no-match{background:#2a2f3a!important;border-color:#3a4150!important;box-shadow:0 6px 14px rgba(0,0,0,.25)!important}
.cat-card.no-match .cat-thumb{filter:none}
.cat-card.no-match .cat-name{color:#f1f5f9}
.cat-card.no-match .cat-dot{background:#8b90a0;box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(58,63,75,.12)}
.cat-card{min-width:0;background:#fff;border:1px solid #e2e8f0;border-radius:8px;box-shadow:0 8px 18px rgba(15,23,42,.08);padding:8px;text-align:left;cursor:pointer;display:block}
.cat-thumb{position:relative;border-radius:6px;overflow:hidden;aspect-ratio:16/9;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#312e81,#1e3a8a)}
.cat-thumb img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;display:block;filter:none!important;opacity:1!important}
.cat-fallback{width:100%;height:100%;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:36px}
.cat-meta{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:10px 4px 4px}
.cat-name{min-width:0;color:#1e293b;font-size:13px;font-weight:800;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap}
.cat-dot{width:10px;height:10px;flex:0 0 10px;border-radius:50%;background:#4f46e5;box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(79,70,229,.12)}
.cat-head{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;margin-bottom:12px}
.cat-head .back-btn{flex:none}
.category-type-filter{display:flex;gap:10px;margin-bottom:14px}
.category-type-filter .filter{min-width:82px;border-color:#2563eb;color:#2563eb;background:#eff6ff}
.category-type-filter .filter.active{border-color:#2563eb;color:#fff;background:#2563eb;box-shadow:0 7px 14px rgba(37,99,235,.2)}
html[data-offline="1"] #networkModal{display:flex!important}
.network-modal{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:2147483000;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:24px;background:rgba(15,23,42,.62);backdrop-filter:blur(6px)}
.network-modal-box{width:100%;max-width:340px;padding:26px 22px;border-radius:20px;background:#fff;text-align:center;box-shadow:0 24px 60px rgba(15,23,42,.28)}
.network-modal-icon{width:52px;height:52px;margin:0 auto 14px;border-radius:50%;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;background:#eff6ff;color:#2563eb;font-size:25px;font-weight:900}
.network-modal-title{font-size:19px;font-weight:900;color:#11182d}
.network-modal-card{width:100%;max-width:330px;padding:30px 24px 26px;border-radius:26px;background:#fff;text-align:center;box-shadow:0 24px 60px rgba(15,23,42,.28);animation:netCardIn .45s cubic-bezier(.2,.9,.3,1.2) both}
.network-modal-card.shake{animation:netShake .45s ease}
.net-wifi{width:92px;height:92px;margin:0 auto 6px;position:relative;animation:netFloat 2.4s ease-in-out infinite}
.net-wifi svg{width:100%;height:100%}
.net-wifi .net-arc{stroke:#c7d2fe;stroke-width:7;stroke-linecap:round;fill:none}
.net-wifi .net-arc.a1{animation:netArc 1.6s ease-in-out infinite}
.net-wifi .net-arc.a2{animation:netArc 1.6s ease-in-out .25s infinite}
.net-wifi .net-arc.a3{animation:netArc 1.6s ease-in-out .5s infinite}
.net-wifi .net-dot{fill:#4f46e5;animation:netDot 1.6s ease-in-out infinite}
.net-wifi .net-cross{stroke:#f43f5e;stroke-width:8;stroke-linecap:round;animation:netCross 1.6s ease-in-out infinite}
.net-spark{position:absolute;border-radius:50%;background:#c7d2fe;animation:netSpark 1.8s ease-in-out infinite}
.net-spark.s1{width:8px;height:8px;top:6px;left:12px}
.net-spark.s2{width:6px;height:6px;top:14px;right:8px;animation-delay:.5s}
.net-spark.s3{width:5px;height:5px;bottom:18px;left:2px;animation-delay:1s}
.network-modal-title{font-size:20px;font-weight:900;color:#11182d;margin-top:8px}
.network-modal-sub{font-size:14px;color:#64748b;margin-top:8px;line-height:1.55}
.net-retry-btn{margin-top:20px;width:100%;height:52px;border-radius:16px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#4f46e5,#2563eb);color:#fff;font-size:16px;font-weight:800;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:9px;box-shadow:0 10px 22px rgba(79,70,229,.32)}
.net-retry-btn:disabled{opacity:.75}
.net-retry-spin{width:18px;height:18px;border-radius:50%;border:2.5px solid rgba(255,255,255,.4);border-top-color:#fff;animation:netSpin .7s linear infinite;display:none}
.net-retry-btn.loading .net-retry-spin{display:block}
.net-retry-btn.loading .net-retry-label{display:none}
@keyframes netSpin{to{transform:rotate(360deg)}}
@keyframes netFloat{0%,100%{transform:translateY(0)}50%{transform:translateY(-9px)}}
@keyframes netArc{0%,100%{stroke:#c7d2fe}50%{stroke:#4f46e5}}
@keyframes netDot{0%,100%{transform:scale(1);opacity:1}50%{transform:scale(1.5);opacity:.7}}
@keyframes netCross{0%,100%{opacity:1}50%{opacity:.35}}
@keyframes netSpark{0%,100%{transform:scale(.6);opacity:.4}50%{transform:scale(1.3);opacity:1}}
@keyframes netCardIn{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(26px) scale(.92)}to{opacity:1;transform:none}}
@keyframes netShake{0%,100%{transform:translateX(0)}20%{transform:translateX(-9px)}40%{transform:translateX(8px)}60%{transform:translateX(-6px)}80%{transform:translateX(4px)}}

/* NAV */
.bottom-nav{position:fixed;bottom:0;left:0;right:0;height:78px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.97);border-top:1px solid #e2e8f0;display:flex;justify-content:space-around;align-items:center;z-index:100;backdrop-filter:blur(12px)}
.nav-btn{flex:1;height:100%;background:none;color:#64748b;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:3px;font-size:10px;font-weight:650}
.nav-icon{font-size:22px;line-height:1}
.nav-btn.active{color:#4f46e5}

/* EMPTY */
.empty{text-align:center;padding:30px 15px;color:#64748b}
.empty-icon{font-size:36px;margin-bottom:8px}

/* MODAL */
.modal{position:fixed;inset:0;background:rgba(15,23,42,.5);display:flex;align-items:flex-end;justify-content:center;z-index:300}
.modal-box{width:100%;max-width:520px;max-height:90vh;overflow:auto;background:#fff;border-radius:24px 24px 0 0;padding:22px}
.modal-head{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;margin-bottom:16px}
.modal-title{font-size:20px;font-weight:900}
.close-btn{width:36px;height:36px;border-radius:50%;background:#f1f5f9;font-size:18px}

/* TOAST */
.toast{position:fixed;left:16px;right:16px;bottom:90px;background:#0f172a;color:#fff;padding:13px 16px;border-radius:14px;text-align:center;font-size:14px;z-index:500;transform:translateY(20px);opacity:0;pointer-events:none;transition:.25s}
.toast.show{transform:translateY(0);opacity:1}

/* NOTIFICATION */
.notif-item{padding:14px 0;border-bottom:1px solid #e2e8f0}
.notif-item.unread{background:#f8fafc;margin:0 -8px;padding:14px 8px;border-radius:12px}
.notif-title{font-weight:800;font-size:15px}
.notif-msg{color:#475569;font-size:13px;margin:4px 0}
.notif-time{font-size:11px;color:#94a3b8}

/* SUPPORT */
.ticket-card{background:#fff;border-radius:16px;padding:16px;margin-bottom:12px;box-shadow:0 2px 10px rgba(0,0,0,.04)}
.ticket-subject{font-weight:800;margin-bottom:4px}
.ticket-meta{font-size:12px;color:#64748b;margin-bottom:8px}
.ticket-msg{background:#f8fafc;padding:12px;border-radius:12px;font-size:13px;margin-bottom:8px}
.admin-reply{background:#e0e7ff;padding:10px 12px;border-radius:12px;font-size:13px;margin-top:6px}

/* REFERRAL */
.ref-code-box{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#4f46e5,#6366f1);color:#fff;border-radius:18px;padding:20px;text-align:center;margin-bottom:16px}
.ref-code{font-size:28px;font-weight:900;letter-spacing:2px;margin:10px 0}
.copy-ref{background:rgba(255,255,255,.2);color:#fff;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.3);padding:10px 20px;border-radius:12px;font-weight:700}

/* PULL TO REFRESH */
.ptr-indicator{position:fixed;top:8px;left:50%;transform:translate3d(-50%,var(--ptr-y,-64px),0);width:42px;height:42px;border-radius:50%;background:#fff;color:#0f172a;font-size:0;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;box-shadow:0 4px 14px rgba(15,23,42,.18);z-index:1200;opacity:0;pointer-events:none;will-change:transform,opacity;transition:transform .3s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1),opacity .18s ease;backface-visibility:hidden}
.ptr-indicator::before{content:"";width:20px;height:20px;border:3px solid #dbe4f0;border-top-color:#2563eb;border-radius:50%;transform:rotate(var(--ptr-rotation,0deg));will-change:transform}
.ptr-indicator.visible{opacity:1}
.ptr-indicator.dragging{transition:none}
.ptr-indicator.spinning::before{animation:tmspin .7s linear infinite}
.ptr-indicator.retracting{transition:transform .32s cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1),opacity .2s ease .1s}
@keyframes tmspin{to{transform:rotate(360deg)}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ptr-indicator{transition-duration:.01ms}.ptr-indicator.spinning::before{animation-duration:1.2s}}
.copy-mini{margin-left:8px;padding:4px 10px;border-radius:9px;background:#eff6ff;color:#2563eb;font-size:11px;font-weight:800;border:1px solid #dbeafe}
.match-head{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;margin-bottom:10px}
.parts-btn{flex:none;padding:7px 12px;border-radius:10px;background:#eff6ff;color:#2563eb;font-size:12px;font-weight:800;border:1px solid #dbeafe}
.copy-line{display:inline-flex;align-items:center}

/* PARTICIPANTS */
.participant-item{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;padding:10px 0;border-bottom:1px solid #e2e8f0;font-size:13px}
.participant-item:last-child{border-bottom:0}
.participant-info{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:2px}
.participant-name{font-weight:700}
.participant-seat{color:#64748b;font-size:12px}
.participant-result{font-weight:700;font-size:12px}
.participant-result.win{color:#16a34a}
.participant-result.loss{color:#b91c1c}

@media(max-width:400px){
  .main{padding:12px}
  .wallet-balance{font-size:28px}
  .seat-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(5,1fr);gap:6px}
  .seat{height:38px;font-size:13px}
}

/* Premium visual layer — functionality and selectors remain unchanged */
:root{
  --ink:#11182d;
  --muted:#718099;
  --line:#e6eaf2;
  --brand:#5b4cf0;
  --brand-deep:#4032bf;
  --brand-soft:#eeedff;
  --mint:#27c6b4;
  --shadow:0 14px 34px rgba(25,33,72,.07);
  --shadow-hover:0 20px 44px rgba(25,33,72,.13);
}
html{background:#f4f6fb;scroll-behavior:smooth}
body{
  background:
    radial-gradient(circle at 100% -5%,rgba(91,76,240,.1),transparent 22rem),
    linear-gradient(135deg,#f9faff 0%,#f1f4fa 100%);
  color:var(--ink);
  letter-spacing:-.012em;
}
body:before{
  content:"";
  position:fixed;
  inset:0;
  pointer-events:none;
  opacity:.3;
  background-image:linear-gradient(rgba(91,76,240,.024) 1px,transparent 1px),linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(91,76,240,.024) 1px,transparent 1px);
  background-size:34px 34px;
  mask-image:linear-gradient(to bottom,#000,transparent 82%);
}
button,input,select,textarea{transition:background-color .2s ease,border-color .2s ease,box-shadow .2s ease,transform .2s ease,opacity .2s ease}
button:focus-visible,input:focus-visible,select:focus-visible,textarea:focus-visible{outline:3px solid rgba(91,76,240,.2);outline-offset:2px}
.auth-page{
  position:relative;
  overflow:hidden;
  background:
    radial-gradient(circle at 12% 10%,rgba(117,103,255,.35),transparent 25rem),
    radial-gradient(circle at 92% 90%,rgba(39,198,180,.2),transparent 23rem),
    linear-gradient(140deg,#0d1429,#1b1b4c 58%,#251d61);
}
.auth-page:before,.auth-page:after{
  content:"";
  position:absolute;
  width:24rem;
  height:24rem;
  border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.1);
  border-radius:50%;
  pointer-events:none;
}
.auth-page:before{top:-12rem;right:-8rem;box-shadow:0 0 0 42px rgba(255,255,255,.025),0 0 0 84px rgba(255,255,255,.018)}
.auth-page:after{bottom:-15rem;left:-9rem}
.auth-box{
  position:relative;
  z-index:1;
  max-width:430px;
  padding:38px 30px;
  border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.72);
  border-radius:30px;
  box-shadow:0 30px 80px rgba(0,0,0,.34),0 0 0 8px rgba(255,255,255,.04);
  animation:panelIn .55s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1) both;
}
.logo{
  background:linear-gradient(135deg,#6758ff,#36cfc2);
  -webkit-background-clip:text;
  background-clip:text;
  color:transparent;
  letter-spacing:-.05em;
}
.auth-title{color:#151c34;letter-spacing:-.045em}
.auth-sub{color:#7b879c}
.field label{color:#65718a;letter-spacing:.02em}
.field input,.form-input{
  border-color:#dfe4ee;
  background:#fbfcfe;
  color:var(--ink);
  box-shadow:inset 0 1px 1px rgba(15,24,48,.02);
}
.field input::placeholder,.form-input::placeholder{color:#a0a9b9}
.field input:hover,.form-input:hover{border-color:#cbd1e2}
.field input:focus,.form-input:focus,textarea:focus{
  border-color:var(--brand);
  background:#fff;
  box-shadow:0 0 0 4px rgba(91,76,240,.12),0 8px 18px rgba(50,44,140,.05);
}
.primary-btn,.form-btn{

/* ==================== SPLASH / LOADING SCREEN (premium white + blue) ==================== */
.splash-screen{
  position:fixed;
  inset:0;
  z-index:9999;
  display:flex;
  align-items:center;
  justify-content:center;
  overflow:hidden;
  background:
    radial-gradient(circle at 50% 6%,rgba(79,70,229,.18),transparent 28rem),
    radial-gradient(circle at 6% 94%,rgba(56,189,248,.16),transparent 24rem),
    linear-gradient(155deg,#ffffff 0%,#f6f9ff 46%,#e9f1ff 100%);
  transition:opacity .5s ease,visibility .5s ease;
}
.splash-screen:before{
  content:"";
  position:absolute;
  inset:0;
  pointer-events:none;
  opacity:.6;
  background-image:
    linear-gradient(rgba(79,70,229,.055) 1px,transparent 1px),
    linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(79,70,229,.055) 1px,transparent 1px);
  background-size:38px 38px;
  -webkit-mask-image:radial-gradient(circle at 50% 42%,#000 0%,transparent 74%);
  mask-image:radial-gradient(circle at 50% 42%,#000 0%,transparent 74%);
}
.splash-screen:after{
  content:"";
  position:absolute;
  width:30rem;
  height:30rem;
  right:-15rem;
  top:-16rem;
  border-radius:50%;
  border:1px solid rgba(79,70,229,.1);
  box-shadow:0 0 0 46px rgba(79,70,229,.03),0 0 0 92px rgba(79,70,229,.018);
  pointer-events:none;
}
.splash-inner{
  position:relative;
  z-index:2;
  display:flex;
  flex-direction:column;
  align-items:center;
  text-align:center;
  padding:0 26px;
  animation:splashIn .75s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1) both;
}
.splash-mark{
  position:relative;
  width:92px;
  height:92px;
  display:flex;
  align-items:center;
  justify-content:center;
  margin-bottom:24px;
}
.splash-ring{
  position:absolute;
  inset:0;
  border-radius:50%;
  border:3px solid rgba(79,70,229,.1);
  border-top-color:#4f46e5;
  border-right-color:#5eb4ff;
  animation:splashSpin 1s linear infinite;
}
.splash-ring.alt{
  inset:13px;
  border-width:2px;
  border-color:rgba(79,70,229,.07);
  border-bottom-color:#8b7cff;
  animation:splashSpin 1.5s linear reverse infinite;
}
.splash-core{
  font-size:22px;
  font-weight:900;
  letter-spacing:-.06em;
  background:linear-gradient(135deg,#2b3fa8,#4f46e5 55%,#5eb4ff);
  -webkit-background-clip:text;
  background-clip:text;
  color:transparent;
}
.splash-logo{
  font-size:43px;
  font-weight:900;
  letter-spacing:-.06em;
  line-height:1;
  background:linear-gradient(135deg,#1e2a72 0%,#4f46e5 46%,#5eb4ff 100%);
  -webkit-background-clip:text;
  background-clip:text;
  color:transparent;
  -webkit-text-fill-color:transparent;
}
.splash-tagline{
  margin-top:12px;
  color:#7a869c;
  font-size:11.5px;
  font-weight:800;
  letter-spacing:.16em;
  text-transform:uppercase;
}
.splash-bar{
  width:190px;
  height:4px;
  margin-top:28px;
  border-radius:99px;
  background:rgba(79,70,229,.12);
  overflow:hidden;
}
.splash-bar i{
  display:block;
  height:100%;
  width:40%;
  border-radius:99px;
  background:linear-gradient(90deg,#4f46e5,#5eb4ff);
  animation:splashBar 1.3s ease-in-out infinite;
}
.splash-note{
  position:absolute;
  left:0;
  right:0;
  bottom:calc(30px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom));
  z-index:2;
  text-align:center;
  color:#98a2b8;
  font-size:12px;
  font-weight:600;
  letter-spacing:.02em;
}
.splash-screen.splash-hide{opacity:0;visibility:hidden;pointer-events:none}
@keyframes splashSpin{to{transform:rotate(360deg)}}
@keyframes splashBar{0%{transform:translateX(-115%)}100%{transform:translateX(265%)}}
@keyframes splashIn{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(16px) scale(.97)}to{opacity:1;transform:none}}

.tm-banner-arrow{position:absolute;top:50%;z-index:7;width:34px;height:34px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;transform:translateY(-50%);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.42);border-radius:50%;background:rgba(17,24,39,.24);backdrop-filter:blur(10px);color:#fff;font-size:22px;line-height:1;box-shadow:0 5px 16px rgba(17,24,39,.13);opacity:.86}
.tm-banner-arrow:active{transform:translateY(-50%) scale(.94)}
.tm-banner-prev{left:10px}.tm-banner-next{right:10px}
.category-section-title{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:11px;margin-top:3px;margin-bottom:17px;font-size:21px;font-weight:900;color:#17203a;letter-spacing:0}
.category-section-title:before{content:"";width:5px;height:29px;flex:0 0 5px;border-radius:2px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#78c85b,#49ad58);box-shadow:0 0 14px rgba(73,173,88,.24)}
@media(max-width:420px){.tm-banner-wrap{aspect-ratio:16/9;min-height:0;border-radius:13px;margin-left:0;margin-right:0}.tm-banner-arrow{width:32px;height:32px}.category-section-title{font-size:21px}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.tm-banner-track{scroll-behavior:auto}.tm-banner-slide img,.tm-banner-dot{transition:none}}

/* Requested cohesive dynamic theme, moderate wallet corners, media alerts and smooth rainbow loaders */
:root{--tm-primary:#c8942f;--tm-primary-deep:#8a5c11;--tm-accent:#ffe9a5;--tm-soft:#fffaf0;--tm-ring-bg:#fff;--tm-on-primary:#11182d;--tm-primary-tint:#fff4d6}
body{background:linear-gradient(145deg,var(--tm-soft),#f8fafc 58%,#eef2f7)}
.header-logo,.logo span,.nav-btn.active,.auth-switch button,.category-type-filter .filter{color:var(--tm-primary)!important}
.primary-btn,.form-btn,.join-btn,.filter.active,.category-type-filter .filter.active,.cat-dot{background:var(--tm-primary)!important;border-color:var(--tm-primary)!important}
.app-header{border-bottom:1px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--tm-primary) 18%,transparent)}
.category-section-title:before{background:linear-gradient(180deg,var(--tm-accent),var(--tm-primary))}
.notice,.room-box{background:var(--tm-soft);color:var(--tm-primary-deep)}
.wallet-hero{border-radius:14px!important;background:var(--tm-wallet-bg)!important;border-color:color-mix(in srgb,var(--tm-accent) 40%,transparent)!important}
.wallet-actions-row .act-btn{border-radius:12px!important}
.act-btn.deposit{background:var(--tm-primary)!important;color:var(--tm-on-primary)!important;border-color:color-mix(in srgb,var(--tm-primary) 75%,#000)!important;box-shadow:0 10px 22px color-mix(in srgb,var(--tm-primary) 25%,transparent)!important}
.act-btn.withdraw{background:var(--tm-primary-tint)!important;color:var(--tm-primary-deep)!important;border-color:color-mix(in srgb,var(--tm-primary) 28%,#fff)!important;box-shadow:0 10px 22px color-mix(in srgb,var(--tm-primary) 16%,transparent)!important}
.custom-logo-wrap{position:relative;display:flex;width:24px;height:24px;align-items:center;justify-content:center}
.custom-menu-logo{position:absolute;inset:0;display:block;width:24px;height:24px;object-fit:contain;border-radius:6px;background:var(--tm-soft)}
.logo-fallback{display:flex;width:24px;height:24px;align-items:center;justify-content:center;border-radius:6px;background:var(--tm-primary-tint);color:var(--tm-primary-deep);font-size:12px;font-weight:900}
.menu-item .mi-icon{background:var(--tm-soft)!important;border:1px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--tm-primary) 16%,transparent)}
.nav-btn.active{background:linear-gradient(180deg,var(--tm-primary-tint),transparent)!important;color:var(--tm-primary-deep)!important}
.nav-btn.active:before{background:var(--tm-primary)!important}
.copy-mini,.parts-btn,.back-btn{background:var(--tm-primary-tint)!important;color:var(--tm-primary-deep)!important;border-color:color-mix(in srgb,var(--tm-primary) 24%,transparent)!important}
.profile-avatar,.cat-count{background:var(--tm-primary)!important;color:var(--tm-on-primary)!important}
#withdrawSubmitBtn{background:var(--tm-primary-tint)!important;color:var(--tm-primary-deep)!important;border:1px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--tm-primary) 30%,transparent)!important;box-shadow:0 10px 22px color-mix(in srgb,var(--tm-primary) 16%,transparent)!important}
.update-actions .form-btn:last-child{color:var(--tm-on-primary)!important}
.filter.active,.category-type-filter .filter.active,.join-btn,.primary-btn,.form-btn{color:var(--tm-on-primary)!important}
.wallet-hero-title,.wallet-chip{color:var(--tm-accent)!important}
.wallet-chip{border-color:color-mix(in srgb,var(--tm-accent) 38%,transparent)!important}
.wallet-cell .wc-value{color:var(--tm-wallet-text,#fff)!important}
.wallet-cell .wc-label,.wallet-cell .wc-hint{color:color-mix(in srgb,var(--tm-wallet-text,#fff) 70%,transparent)!important}
#page-deposit>.card,#page-withdraw>.card{border-radius:14px}
.notif-item{padding:14px;border:1px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--tm-primary) 14%,#e2e8f0);border-radius:10px;margin-bottom:10px;background:#fff}

.vs-timer{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:8px;margin:0 0 12px;padding:11px 13px;border-radius:12px;background:#eef3ff;color:#31416f;font-size:12px;font-weight:700}
.vs-timer b{font-size:14px;color:#1b2a56;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.vs-team small{display:block;margin-top:5px;color:#7f879b}
.vs-team.full{opacity:.55}
.vs-vs{display:grid;place-items:center;margin:9px 0;font-size:11px;font-weight:900;letter-spacing:.14em;color:#98a1b8}
.vs-room{margin-top:12px;padding:13px;border-radius:14px;background:#0f2143;color:#fff}
.vs-room small{display:block;font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.12em;color:#9db4de}
.vs-room-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:10px;margin-top:9px}
.vs-room-grid b{display:block;font-size:15px;word-break:break-all}
.vs-room-lock{margin-top:8px;font-size:13px;font-weight:800;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.vs-mine{margin-top:12px;padding:12px 13px;border-radius:13px;border:1px solid #dfe4f1;background:#fbfcff;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:10px}
.vs-mine b{color:#17213c}
.vs-mine small{display:block;color:#7f879b;margin-top:3px}
.vs-mine.win{border-color:#1fa87a;background:#f1fff9}
.vs-mine.loss{border-color:#e2b6bf;background:#fff6f7}
.vs-mine.cancel{border-color:#e0c79a;background:#fffaf0}
.vs-amount{font-weight:900;color:#17213c;white-space:nowrap}
.vs-amount.win{color:#128a61}
.vs-note{margin-top:10px;font-size:12px;color:#8a92a6;text-align:center}

/* Keep VS Tournament and Task Complete on the normal page backdrop, without a panel behind them. */
#page-luckynumber,#page-taskcomplete{background:transparent;min-height:0}
/* Center the back glyph inside its existing box without moving the box. */
#page-luckyrewards .back-btn,#page-luckynumber .back-btn,#page-taskcomplete .back-btn,#page-history .back-btn{display:grid;place-items:center;line-height:1;padding-bottom:2px}
/* Lucky & Rewards: match the Bank page header and keep the normal app backdrop. */
.lr-feature-open:has(#page-luckyrewards.active) .app-header{display:flex!important}
#page-luckyrewards{background:transparent;min-height:0;padding-bottom:24px}
#page-luckyrewards .lr-bank-head{margin-bottom:18px}
#page-luckyrewards .bank-welcome small{letter-spacing:.1em}
#page-luckyrewards .bank-welcome b{font-size:21px}
#page-luckyrewards .lr-hero{background:linear-gradient(130deg,#0962c9,#168de9 66%,#35b5ee);box-shadow:0 16px 32px rgba(14,104,202,.22)}
#page-luckyrewards .lr-options{margin:18px 0 12px}
#page-luckyrewards .lr-option{min-height:118px;padding:18px 14px;border-radius:16px}
#page-luckyrewards .lr-history-bottom{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:10px;width:100%;min-height:48px;border:1px solid #dce6f4;border-radius:13px;background:#fff;color:#175ab2;font-size:14px;font-weight:800;box-shadow:0 6px 16px rgba(24,61,116,.06)}
#page-luckyrewards .lr-history-bottom span:last-child{margin-left:2px}
/* Task Complete cards: straight and centered, no blue strip above, premium card finish. */
#page-taskcomplete .lr-ticket{position:relative;isolation:isolate;border-radius:20px;border:1px solid rgba(20,38,70,.09);background:linear-gradient(180deg,#fff 0%,#fdfdff 48%,#fafcfe 100%);box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(16,34,66,.05),0 16px 34px -16px rgba(16,34,66,.22),inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.9);transform:none;transition:transform .28s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.25,1),box-shadow .28s ease,border-color .28s ease}
#page-taskcomplete .lr-ticket:nth-child(even){transform:none}
#page-taskcomplete .lr-ticket-band{display:none}
#page-taskcomplete .lr-ticket-body{padding:19px 18px}
#page-taskcomplete .lr-ticket-cut{position:relative;margin-left:-18px;margin-right:-18px;border-color:rgba(20,38,70,.1)}
#page-taskcomplete .lr-ticket-cut:before,#page-taskcomplete .lr-ticket-cut:after{content:"";position:absolute;top:50%;width:18px;height:18px;border-radius:50%;background:#f4f7fb;transform:translateY(-50%)}
#page-taskcomplete .lr-ticket-cut:before{left:-27px}
#page-taskcomplete .lr-ticket-cut:after{right:-27px}
#page-taskcomplete .lr-ticket-meta div{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#f9fbfd,#f4f8fc);border:1px solid rgba(20,38,70,.06);border-radius:12px;box-shadow:inset 0 1px 0 #fff}
#page-taskcomplete .lr-ticket-open{color:#0f6cd6;letter-spacing:.01em}
#page-taskcomplete .lr-ticket:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);border-color:rgba(20,38,70,.14);box-shadow:0 2px 3px rgba(16,34,66,.06),0 22px 42px -18px rgba(16,34,66,.28),inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.9)}
#page-taskcomplete .lr-ticket:active{transform:translateY(0) scale(.99)}
/* Completed tasks show a small self-contained acknowledgement, never the code form. */
.lr-done-modal{align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:20px}
.lr-done-box{position:relative;width:100%;max-width:360px;padding:31px 24px 24px;overflow:hidden;border:1px solid #dce9fa;border-radius:20px;background:#fff;box-shadow:0 25px 65px rgba(8,49,109,.22);text-align:center;animation:lrDoneIn .36s cubic-bezier(.2,.9,.25,1.15) both}
.lr-done-box:before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0 0 auto;height:6px;background:#0867d7}
.lr-done-close{position:absolute;top:13px;right:14px;width:30px;height:30px;border-radius:50%;background:#f1f5fb;color:#6b7891;font-size:21px;line-height:1}
.lr-done-icon{display:grid;place-items:center;width:64px;height:64px;margin:4px auto 14px;border-radius:50%;background:#e6f8f0;color:#0d9b69;font-size:34px;font-weight:800;animation:lrDoneCheck .42s .12s both}
.lr-done-kicker{color:#1477d4;font-size:10px;font-weight:900;letter-spacing:.14em}
.lr-done-box h3{margin:7px 0;color:#17213c;font-size:22px}
.lr-done-box p{color:#64738c;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55}
.lr-done-box p strong{color:#243758}
.lr-done-reward{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;margin:19px 0 16px;padding:12px 14px;border:1px dashed #a8c9ec;border-radius:10px;background:#f2f8ff}
.lr-done-reward span{color:#687994;font-size:10px;font-weight:900;letter-spacing:.07em}
.lr-done-reward b{color:#0867d7;font-size:18px}
.lr-done-confirm{width:100%;height:46px;border-radius:10px;background:#0867d7;color:#fff;font-size:14px;font-weight:800}
@keyframes lrDoneIn{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(18px) scale(.96)}to{opacity:1;transform:none}}
@keyframes lrDoneCheck{from{opacity:0;transform:scale(.55) rotate(-14deg)}to{opacity:1;transform:none}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.lr-done-box,.lr-done-icon{animation:none!important}#page-taskcomplete .lr-ticket{transition:none!important}}
/* Keep every wallet detail legible as the admin switches between light and dark designs. */
.wallet-hero.atm-card{--wallet-detail:var(--tm-wallet-text,#fff);--wallet-subtle:color-mix(in srgb,var(--wallet-detail) 82%,transparent);transition:background .45s ease,border-color .45s ease,box-shadow .45s ease}
.wallet-hero.atm-card .wallet-hero-title,.wallet-hero.atm-card .wallet-chip,.wallet-hero.atm-card .wc-value,.wallet-hero.atm-card .wc-label,.wallet-hero.atm-card .wc-hint,.wallet-hero.atm-card .wallet-account-label,.wallet-hero.atm-card .wallet-account-number,.wallet-hero.atm-card .wallet-icon-btn{transition:color .4s ease,background-color .4s ease,border-color .4s ease}
.wallet-hero.atm-card .wallet-account{border-top-color:color-mix(in srgb,var(--wallet-detail) 23%,transparent)}
.wallet-hero.atm-card .wallet-account-label{color:var(--wallet-subtle)}
.wallet-hero.atm-card .wallet-account-number,.wallet-hero.atm-card .wallet-icon-btn{color:var(--wallet-detail)!important;border-color:color-mix(in srgb,var(--wallet-detail) 24%,transparent)!important;background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--wallet-detail) 9%,transparent)!important}
.wallet-hero.atm-card .wallet-account-number[data-visible="1"]{background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--wallet-detail) 14%,transparent)!important}
.wallet-hero.atm-card .wallet-account-number:focus-visible,.wallet-hero.atm-card .wallet-icon-btn:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--wallet-detail);outline-offset:2px}
body[data-wd="20"] .wallet-hero.atm-card{--wallet-subtle:color-mix(in srgb,var(--wallet-detail) 80%,transparent)}
body[data-wd="20"] .wallet-hero.atm-card .wc-label,body[data-wd="20"] .wallet-hero.atm-card .wc-hint{color:var(--wallet-subtle)!important}
body[data-wd="20"] .wallet-hero.atm-card .wallet-chip{background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--wallet-detail) 7%,transparent)}
body[data-wd="22"] .wallet-hero.atm-card,body[data-wd="26"] .wallet-hero.atm-card{background-image:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(0,0,0,.12),rgba(0,0,0,.62)),var(--tm-wallet-bg)!important}
body[data-wd="22"] .wallet-hero.atm-card .wallet-chip,body[data-wd="26"] .wallet-hero.atm-card .wallet-chip{background:rgba(0,0,0,.38)}
body[data-wd="27"] .wallet-hero.atm-card{--wallet-detail:#fff;--wallet-subtle:rgba(255,255,255,.84);background-image:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(50,27,3,.58),rgba(50,27,3,.5)),var(--tm-wallet-bg)!important}
body[data-wd="27"] .wallet-hero.atm-card .wallet-hero-title,body[data-wd="27"] .wallet-hero.atm-card .wallet-chip,body[data-wd="27"] .wallet-hero.atm-card .wc-value{color:#fff!important}
body[data-wd="27"] .wallet-hero.atm-card .wc-label,body[data-wd="27"] .wallet-hero.atm-card .wc-hint{color:var(--wallet-subtle)!important}
body[data-wd="27"] .wallet-hero.atm-card .wallet-chip{background:rgba(50,27,3,.38)}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.wallet-hero.atm-card,.wallet-hero.atm-card .wallet-hero-title,.wallet-hero.atm-card .wallet-chip,.wallet-hero.atm-card .wc-value,.wallet-hero.atm-card .wc-label,.wallet-hero.atm-card .wc-hint,.wallet-hero.atm-card .wallet-account-label,.wallet-hero.atm-card .wallet-account-number,.wallet-hero.atm-card .wallet-icon-btn{transition:none}}
</style>
<style id="tm-approved-ice-styles">
/* Lucky & Rewards only: light rain, circling frost and a five-second crystallisation. */
#page-luckyrewards,#page-luckynumber,#page-taskcomplete{position:relative;isolation:isolate}
.tm-ice-veil{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:140;pointer-events:none;overflow:hidden;opacity:0;visibility:hidden;background:rgba(217,246,253,.08)}
.tm-ice-veil.active{opacity:1;visibility:visible;animation:tmIceVeil 5s ease-out forwards}
.tm-ice-veil .tm-mist{position:absolute;left:50%;top:50%;width:min(110vmax,900px);height:min(110vmax,900px);border-radius:50%;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);background:conic-gradient(from 10deg,transparent,rgba(200,240,248,.32),transparent,rgba(238,252,255,.47),transparent);filter:blur(28px);animation:tmMistSpin 5s ease-in-out forwards}
.tm-ice-veil .tm-frost{position:absolute;inset:0;background:radial-gradient(circle at 50% 50%,transparent 24%,rgba(206,238,247,.28) 65%,rgba(237,251,255,.67) 95%),repeating-linear-gradient(125deg,transparent 0 40px,rgba(255,255,255,.16) 41px,transparent 44px);animation:tmFrostGrow 5s ease-out forwards}
.tm-ice-veil .tm-rain{position:absolute;inset:-15% 0;background-image:linear-gradient(175deg,transparent 40%,rgba(223,251,255,.9) 55%,transparent 72%);background-size:43px 105px;mask-image:repeating-linear-gradient(90deg,#000 0 1px,transparent 1px 39px);opacity:.35;animation:tmRainFall 1.2s linear infinite}
.tm-ice-veil .tm-drops{position:absolute;inset:0;background:radial-gradient(ellipse 2px 9px at 16% 25%,rgba(255,255,255,.9) 50%,transparent),radial-gradient(ellipse 3px 11px at 81% 57%,rgba(226,249,255,.85) 50%,transparent),radial-gradient(ellipse 2px 8px at 39% 70%,rgba(255,255,255,.9) 50%,transparent);animation:tmDrops 5s ease-in forwards}
@keyframes tmIceVeil{0%{opacity:0}8%{opacity:1}75%{opacity:1}100%{opacity:0;visibility:hidden}}
@keyframes tmMistSpin{0%{transform:translate(-50%,-50%) rotate(-50deg) scale(.44);opacity:0}35%{opacity:.95}75%{opacity:.8}100%{transform:translate(-50%,-50%) rotate(195deg) scale(1.32);opacity:0}}
@keyframes tmFrostGrow{0%,12%{opacity:0;clip-path:circle(0% at 50% 50%)}65%{opacity:.8;clip-path:circle(80% at 50% 50%)}100%{opacity:0;clip-path:circle(120% at 50% 50%)}}
@keyframes tmRainFall{to{background-position:0 210px}}@keyframes tmDrops{0%,50%{opacity:0;transform:translateY(-18px)}70%{opacity:1}100%{opacity:0;transform:translateY(45px)}}
#page-luckyrewards.tm-frost-content .lr-hero,#page-luckynumber.tm-frost-content .lr-game,#page-taskcomplete.tm-frost-content .lr-ticket{animation:tmCrystalSet .65s ease-out both}
@keyframes tmCrystalSet{from{opacity:.75;filter:brightness(1.2);transform:translateY(8px)}to{opacity:1;filter:brightness(1);transform:none}}
.tm-winner-note{position:relative;background:#fff!important;border:1px solid #bcd9e2!important;border-left:4px solid #3c9ca9!important;border-radius:8px!important;box-shadow:0 8px 20px rgba(26,77,91,.11)!important;animation:tmWinnerNote .42s ease-out both;overflow:hidden}
.tm-winner-note:after{content:"✦";position:absolute;right:14px;top:12px;color:#4eacb8;font-size:24px;animation:tmSparkle 2.5s ease-in-out infinite}
.tm-winner-note .notif-title{color:#174f61;font-weight:800;padding-right:30px}
@keyframes tmWinnerNote{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(8px) scale(.98)}to{opacity:1;transform:none}}@keyframes tmSparkle{50%{opacity:.45;transform:scale(.82)}}
#page-luckynumber .lr-game{border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;border:1px solid #dce7f2;box-shadow:0 10px 26px rgba(21,67,101,.07)}
#page-luckynumber .lr-game-top{align-items:flex-start;gap:12px}#page-luckynumber .lr-game-top h3{overflow-wrap:anywhere}
#page-luckynumber .lr-game-meta{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:6px;align-items:stretch}#page-luckynumber .lr-game-meta span{min-width:0;text-align:center;overflow-wrap:anywhere;display:grid;place-items:center}
#page-luckynumber .lr-number-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:9px}
#page-luckynumber .vs-team{min-width:0;border-radius:8px;transition:border-color .2s,background-color .2s,box-shadow .2s,transform .2s}#page-luckynumber .vs-team.selected{box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(77,135,209,.14);transform:translateY(-2px)}
#page-luckynumber .lr-join{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) minmax(110px,auto);gap:10px;align-items:stretch}#page-luckynumber .lr-join input{min-width:0;width:100%;margin:0}#page-luckynumber .lr-join button{min-height:48px;white-space:normal}
#page-luckynumber .vs-room{border-radius:8px}#page-luckynumber .vs-room-grid{min-width:0}#page-luckynumber .vs-room-grid>div{min-width:0}#page-luckynumber .vs-room-grid b{overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.vs-join-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) minmax(128px,44%);gap:10px;align-items:stretch;margin-top:13px}.vs-entry-chip{display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center;gap:2px;min-width:0;padding:10px 14px;border:1px solid #e3e7f3;border-radius:14px;background:#f7f8fd}.vs-entry-chip small{font-size:9px;font-weight:900;letter-spacing:.12em;color:#8b93a8}.vs-entry-chip b{font-size:17px;font-weight:900;color:#1d2a51}.vs-join-btn{min-height:50px;padding:12px 14px;border-radius:14px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#4258d8,#5f6fe6);color:#fff;font-weight:900;font-size:14px;white-space:normal;line-height:1.25;box-shadow:0 10px 22px rgba(66,88,216,.24)}.vs-join-btn:disabled{box-shadow:none;opacity:1}.vs-join-btn.closed{background:#eef1f7;color:#8b93a8}.vs-join-btn.waiting{background:#fff6e2;color:#9a6b12;border:1px solid #f0dcaa;box-shadow:none}.vs-lock-note{margin-top:9px;font-size:12px;color:#8a7434;background:#fffaf0;border:1px solid #f1e2bd;border-radius:12px;padding:9px 12px}.tm-btn-busy{opacity:.62!important;cursor:progress!important;filter:saturate(.75)}@media(max-width:380px){.vs-join-row{grid-template-columns:1fr}}@media(max-width:390px){#page-luckynumber .lr-game-meta{font-size:11px}#page-luckynumber .lr-join{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) minmax(100px,42%)}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.tm-winner-note,.tm-winner-note:after,.tm-ice-veil,.tm-ice-veil *,#page-luckyrewards.tm-frost-content .lr-hero,#page-luckynumber.tm-frost-content .lr-game,#page-taskcomplete.tm-frost-content .lr-ticket{animation:none!important;transition:none!important}.tm-ice-veil{display:none!important}}
</style>
</head>
<body>

<!-- ==================== SPLASH / LOADING ==================== -->
<div id="splashScreen" class="splash-screen">
  <div class="splash-inner">
    <div class="splash-mark">
      <div class="splash-ring"></div>
      <div class="splash-ring alt"></div>
      <div class="splash-core">TM</div>
    </div>
    <div class="splash-logo">TM<span>Game</span></div>
    <div class="splash-tagline">Premium Tournaments</div>
    <div class="splash-bar"><i></i></div>
  </div>
  <div class="splash-note">Loading your experience…</div>
</div>

<!-- ==================== AUTH ==================== -->
<div id="authPage" class="auth-page hidden">
  <div class="auth-box">
    <div class="logo">TM<span>Game</span></div>

    <div id="loginBox">
      <h1 class="auth-title">Welcome Back</h1>
      <p class="auth-sub">Login to continue</p>
      <div class="field"><label>Email</label><input id="loginEmail" type="email" autocomplete="email" placeholder="Enter your email"></div>
      <div class="field"><label>Password</label><input id="loginPassword" type="password" autocomplete="current-password" placeholder="Enter password"></div>
      <button class="primary-btn" onclick="window.loginUser()">Login</button>
      <div class="auth-switch">Don't have an account? <button onclick="window.showRegister()">Register</button></div>
    </div>

    <div id="registerBox" class="hidden">
      <h1 class="auth-title">Create Account</h1>
      <p class="auth-sub">Join TMGame</p>
      <div class="field"><label>Name</label><input id="registerName" type="text" maxlength="24" placeholder="Your name"></div>
      <div class="auth-hint">Name must be unique - it can't match another player.</div>
      <div class="field"><label>Email</label><input id="registerEmail" type="email" placeholder="Your email"></div>
      <div class="field"><label>Phone (10 digits)</label><input id="registerPhone" type="tel" inputmode="numeric" maxlength="10" placeholder="Enter 10 digit mobile number"></div>
      <div class="auth-hint">Only 10 digits allowed and each number can be used once.</div>
      <div class="field"><label>Password</label><input id="registerPassword" type="password" autocomplete="new-password" minlength="6" placeholder="Enter password"></div>
      <div class="field"><label>Referral Code (Optional)</label><input id="registerReferral" type="text" placeholder="Enter referral code if any"></div>
      <button class="primary-btn" onclick="window.registerUser()">Create Account</button>
      <div class="auth-switch">Already have an account? <button onclick="window.showLogin()">Login</button></div>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>

<!-- ==================== APP ==================== -->
<div id="app" class="hidden">
  <header class="app-header">
    <div id="headerName" class="header-logo">User</div>
    
    <div class="header-actions">
      <button id="headerSubscriptionCoin" class="header-coin-btn" type="button" onclick="window.openPage('subscription')" aria-label="Subscription status" title="Subscription Plus">🪙</button>
      <button id="headerNotification" class="header-notification-btn" type="button" onclick="window.openNotifications()" aria-label="Notifications">
        <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M18 8a6 6 0 0 0-12 0c0 7-3 7-3 9h18c0-2-3-2-3-9"></path><path d="M13.7 21a2 2 0 0 1-3.4 0"></path></svg>
      </button>
      <button id="headerUser" class="header-user header-menu-btn" type="button" onclick="window.toggleUserMenu()" aria-label="Open menu" aria-expanded="false"><span aria-hidden="true">☰</span></button>
    </div>
  </header>

  <main class="main">

    <!-- HOME -->
    <section id="page-home" class="page active home-glass-stage">
      <div id="creditAlert" class="credit-alert hidden" role="status"></div>
      <div id="homeNoticeBoard" class="hidden" aria-live="polite"></div>
      <div id="homeBannerWrap" class="tm-banner-wrap hidden" aria-label="TMGame featured banners">
        <div id="homeBannerTrack" class="tm-banner-track"></div>
        <button id="homeBannerPrev" class="tm-banner-arrow tm-banner-prev" type="button" aria-label="Previous banner">‹</button>
        <button id="homeBannerNext" class="tm-banner-arrow tm-banner-next" type="button" aria-label="Next banner">›</button>
        <div id="homeBannerDots" class="tm-banner-dots" aria-label="Banner position"></div>
      </div>
      <div id="homeBlockNotice" class="block-notice hidden" style="margin-bottom:16px">
        🔒 Your account has been blocked by TMGame. You can only access Customer Support.
      </div>
      <div id="categorySection">
        <div class="section-title category-section-title">Game Category</div>
        <div id="categorySlider" class="cat-slider"></div>
      </div>
    </section>

    <!-- TOURNAMENTS -->
    <section id="page-tournaments" class="page">
      <div class="section-title">Tournaments</div>
      <div id="tournamentBlockNotice" class="block-notice hidden">
        🔒 Your account is restricted. Contact support or wait for TMGame approval.
      </div>
      <div class="filter-row">
        <button class="filter active" onclick="window.setTournamentFilter('all',this)">All</button>
        <button class="filter" onclick="window.setTournamentFilter('free',this)">Free</button>
        <button class="filter" onclick="window.setTournamentFilter('paid',this)">Paid</button>
        <button class="filter" onclick="window.setTournamentFilter('upcoming',this)">Upcoming</button>
        <button class="filter" onclick="window.setTournamentFilter('endmatch',this)">End Match</button>
        <button class="filter" onclick="window.setTournamentFilter('complete',this)">Complete</button>

  <div id="networkCard" class="network-modal-card">
    <div class="net-wifi">
      <span class="net-spark s1"></span><span class="net-spark s2"></span><span class="net-spark s3"></span>
      <svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" aria-hidden="true">
        <path class="net-arc a3" d="M14 40 Q50 12 86 40"/>
        <path class="net-arc a2" d="M25 55 Q50 35 75 55"/>
        <path class="net-arc a1" d="M36 70 Q50 58 64 70"/>
        <circle class="net-dot" cx="50" cy="82" r="6"/>
        <line class="net-cross" x1="20" y1="18" x2="82" y2="88"/>
      </svg>
    </div>
    <div id="networkModalTitle" class="network-modal-title">No Internet Connection</div>
    <div class="network-modal-sub">Please turn on your network and try again.<br>We could not reach the game server.</div>
    <button id="netRetryBtn" class="net-retry-btn" type="button">
      <span class="net-retry-spin"></span>
      <span class="net-retry-label">Retry</span>
    </button>
  </div>
</div>

<script>
(function(){
  var checking = false;

  function els(){
    return {
      modal: document.getElementById("networkModal"),
      card: document.getElementById("networkCard"),
      btn: document.getElementById("netRetryBtn"),
      splash: document.getElementById("splashScreen")
    };
  }

  function showCard(){
    var e = els();
    if(!e.modal) return;
    e.modal.classList.remove("hidden");
    /* The network card is enough; never restart the opening splash here. */
  }

  function hideCard(){
    var e = els();
    if(e.modal) e.modal.classList.add("hidden");
  }

  /* Ping Firebase (Realtime DB shallow ping, else Firestore endpoint).
     Any HTTP response = reachable. Timeout/abort/error = not reachable. */
  function pingFirebase(){
    return new Promise(function(resolve){
      if(!navigator.onLine) return resolve(false);
      var url = "https://firestore.googleapis.com/";
      try{
        var saved = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem("tmgameFirebaseConfig") || "null");
        var cfg = Object.assign({projectId:"tmgame-com", databaseURL:"https://tmgame-com-default-rtdb.firebaseio.com"}, saved || {});
        if(cfg.databaseURL){
          url = String(cfg.databaseURL).replace(/\/+$/,"") + "/.json?shallow=true";
        }else if(cfg.projectId){
          url = "https://firestore.googleapis.com/v1/projects/" + encodeURIComponent(cfg.projectId) + "/databases/(default)/documents";
        }
      }catch(e){}
      var done = false;
      function finish(ok){ if(done) return; done = true; resolve(ok); }
      var ctrl = ("AbortController" in window) ? new AbortController() : null;
      var timer = window.setTimeout(function(){ if(ctrl) try{ ctrl.abort(); }catch(e){} finish(false); }, 7000);
      fetch(url, { signal: ctrl ? ctrl.signal : undefined, cache: "no-store" })
        .then(function(){ window.clearTimeout(timer); finish(true); })
        .catch(function(){ window.clearTimeout(timer); finish(false); });
    });
  }

  /* Check the connection without replacing the current screen or reloading it. */
  function gateCheck(fromRetry){
    if(checking || !navigator.onLine){ if(!navigator.onLine) lockOn(); return; }
    checking = true;
    var e = els();
    if(e.btn){ e.btn.disabled = true; e.btn.classList.add("loading"); }
    pingFirebase().then(function(ok){
      checking = false;
      var e2 = els();
      if(e2.btn){ e2.btn.disabled = false; e2.btn.classList.remove("loading"); }
      if(ok){
        hideCard();
      }else{
        showCard();
        if(fromRetry && e2.card){
          e2.card.classList.remove("shake");
          void e2.card.offsetWidth;
          e2.card.classList.add("shake");
        }
      }
    });
  }

  function syncNetwork(){
    if(!navigator.onLine){
      lockOn();
    }else if(offlineLock){
      gateCheck(false);
    }
  }

  document.addEventListener("click", function(ev){
    var t = ev.target && ev.target.closest ? ev.target.closest("#netRetryBtn") : null;
    if(t) gateCheck(true);
  });

  /* ===== OFFLINE HARD LOCK: no action works while network is off ===== */
  var offlineLock = false;
  function lockOn(){
    offlineLock = true;
    document.documentElement.setAttribute("data-offline","1");
    try{ if(document.activeElement && document.activeElement.blur) document.activeElement.blur(); }catch(e){}
    showCard();
  }
  function lockOff(){
    offlineLock = false;
    document.documentElement.removeAttribute("data-offline");
  }
  window.tmIsOffline = function(){ return offlineLock || !navigator.onLine; };
  var bootPending = false;
  function blockIfOffline(ev){
    if(!(offlineLock || bootPending || !navigator.onLine)) return;
    var t = ev.target;
    if(t && t.closest && t.closest("#netRetryBtn")) return;
    ev.preventDefault();
    ev.stopPropagation();
    if(ev.stopImmediatePropagation) ev.stopImmediatePropagation();
    if(!bootPending) lockOn();
  }
  ["click","pointerdown","pointerup","touchstart","touchend","mousedown","submit","change","input","keydown"].forEach(function(type){
    window.addEventListener(type, blockIfOffline, {capture:true, passive:false});
  });
  /* keep the network page on top; cannot be closed while offline */
  window.setInterval(function(){
    if(!navigator.onLine){
      lockOn();
    }else if(offlineLock && !checking){
      gateCheck(true);
    }
  }, 2500);
  var _showCard = showCard;

  /* Live server check used before every money/join action */

  };
  /* Background heartbeat: real server reachability every 4s (not just phone flag) */
  var hbBusy = false;
  window.setInterval(function(){
    if(hbBusy || checking || offlineLock || document.hidden) return;
    hbBusy = true;
    pingFirebase().then(function(ok){ hbBusy = false; if(!ok) lockOn(); });
  }, 4000);
  document.addEventListener("visibilitychange", function(){ if(!document.hidden && !checking) syncNetwork(); });
  window.addEventListener("offline", lockOn);
  window.addEventListener("online", function(){ gateCheck(false); });
  function bootCheck(){
    /* block taps until the server is confirmed reachable on every app open/refresh */
    bootPending = true;
    pingFirebase().then(function(ok){
      bootPending = false;
      if(!ok) lockOn();
    });

const SPLASH_MIN_MS = 420;

let splashSyncPromise = null;
let isSigningOut = false;

/* Real background data refresh performed while the loading screen is visible. */
async function runBackgroundSync(){
  if(!navigator.onLine || isSigningOut) return;
  try{
    if(currentUser) await loadEverything();
    else await loadSettings();
  }catch(e){
    console.error("Background sync error:", e);
  }
}

function showSplash(){
  const splash = document.getElementById("splashScreen");
  if(!splash) return;
  splashShownAt = Date.now();
  splash.classList.remove("hidden");
  // force a frame so the fade-in transition actually plays
  requestAnimationFrame(() => splash.classList.remove("splash-hide"));
  // kick off a genuine data refresh behind the loading visual
  splashSyncPromise = runBackgroundSync();
}

function hideSplash(){
  if(!navigator.onLine) return;
  const splash = document.getElementById("splashScreen");
  if(!splash || splash.classList.contains("hidden")) return;
  const pending = splashSyncPromise || Promise.resolve();
  splashSyncPromise = null;
  Promise.resolve(pending).catch(()=>{}).then(() => {
    const wait = Math.max(0, SPLASH_MIN_MS - (Date.now() - splashShownAt));
    window.setTimeout(() => {
      splash.classList.add("splash-hide");
      window.setTimeout(() => splash.classList.add("hidden"), 260);
    }, wait);
  });
}

    });

      if(!/[0-9]/.test(ev.key)) { ev.preventDefault(); return; }
      if(el.value.replace(/\D/g,"").length >= 10 && el.selectionStart === el.selectionEnd) ev.preventDefault();
    });
    el.addEventListener("paste", function(ev){
      ev.preventDefault();
      const txt = (ev.clipboardData || window.clipboardData).getData("text") || "";
      el.value = (el.value + txt).replace(/\D/g,"").slice(0,10);
    });
  }

onAuthStateChanged(auth, async (user) => {

      b.classList.remove("active");
      if (b.dataset.page === "home") b.classList.add("active");
    });

    startCompetitionListeners();
    startSettingsListener();
    /* Load the user's ID details (name, balance, account) while the splash still covers Home. */
    try{ await Promise.race([loadUser(), new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 8000))]); }catch(e){}
    if(currentUser !== user) return;
    /* Show the already-rendered app now; a slow data refresh must not trap it on loading. */
    hideSplash();
    loadEverything().then(() => {
      if(currentUser === user) startNotificationListener();
    }).catch(e => console.error("Load error:", e));
  } else {
    // Logged out → back to the auth (register/login) page
    if(notificationUnsubscribe){ notificationUnsubscribe(); notificationUnsubscribe=null; }

    if(settingsUnsubscribe){ try{ settingsUnsubscribe(); }catch(e){} settingsUnsubscribe=null; }

    document.getElementById("app").classList.add("hidden");
    document.getElementById("authPage").classList.remove("hidden");
    window.showLogin();

    hideSplash();
  }
});

async function syncFirebaseConfigFromCloud(){
  try{
    const snap = await getDoc(doc(db,"settings","firebaseConfig"));
    if(!snap.exists()) return;
    const d = snap.data() || {};
    if(!d.apiKey || !d.projectId || !d.appId) return;
    const next = {
      apiKey: String(d.apiKey),
      authDomain: String(d.authDomain || ""),
      databaseURL: String(d.databaseURL || ""),
      projectId: String(d.projectId),
      storageBucket: String(d.storageBucket || ""),
      messagingSenderId: String(d.messagingSenderId || ""),
      appId: String(d.appId),
      measurementId: String(d.measurementId || "")
    };
    const current = JSON.stringify(resolveFirebaseConfig());
    if(JSON.stringify(Object.assign({}, defaultFirebaseConfig, next)) === current) return;
    localStorage.setItem(FB_CONFIG_KEY, JSON.stringify(next));
    location.reload();
  }catch(e){}
}

/* ========== LEADERBOARD RESET + BONUS COUNTDOWN ========== */
function lbToMillis(t){
  if(!t) return 0;
  if(typeof t === "number") return t;
  if(typeof t.toMillis === "function") return t.toMillis();
  if(t.seconds) return Number(t.seconds) * 1000;
  const n = new Date(t).getTime();
  return isNaN(n) ? 0 : n;
}
/* Reset moment = when admin switched the leaderboard back ON */
function lbResetAt(){
  let local = 0;
  try{ local = Number(localStorage.getItem("tmLbResetAt") || 0) || 0; }catch(e){}
  return Math.max(Number(settings.leaderboardResetAt || 0), local);
}
function lbTrackToggle(enabled){
  let stored = null;
  try{ stored = localStorage.getItem("tmLbEnabledState"); }catch(e){}
  const prev = stored === null ? null : stored === "1";
  if(prev === false && enabled === true){
    try{ localStorage.setItem("tmLbResetAt", String(Date.now())); }catch(e){}
  }
  try{ localStorage.setItem("tmLbEnabledState", enabled ? "1" : "0"); }catch(e){}
}
function lbCountReferrals(users){
  const reset = lbResetAt();
  const counts = {};
  users.forEach(u => {
    if(!(u.referredBy && u.firstDepositRewarded)) return;
    if(reset){
      const t = lbToMillis(u.firstDepositRewardedAt || u.firstDepositAt || u.createdAt);
      if(t && t < reset) return;
    }
    counts[u.referredBy] = (counts[u.referredBy] || 0) + 1;
  });
  return counts;
}
function lbWeekStart(now){
  const d = new Date(now.getTime());
  d.setHours(0,0,0,0);
  const day = d.getDay();
  d.setDate(d.getDate() - (day === 0 ? 6 : day - 1));
  return d;
}
function lbMonthStart(now){
  return new Date(now.getFullYear(), now.getMonth(), 1, 0, 0, 0, 0);
}
const LB_DAY_NAMES = ["Sunday","Monday","Tuesday","Wednesday","Thursday","Friday","Saturday"];
function lbWeeklyDay(){
  const n = Number(settings.weeklyBonusDay);
  return (isNaN(n) || n < 0 || n > 6) ? 0 : n;
}
function lbMonthlyDay(){
  const v = settings.monthlyBonusDay;
  if(v == null || v === "last") return "last";
  const n = Number(v);
  if(isNaN(n) || n < 1 || n > 31) return "last";
  return n;
}
/* Next occurrence of the admin-selected weekly bonus day */
function lbNextWeekly(now){
  const target = lbWeeklyDay();
  const d = new Date(now.getTime());
  d.setHours(0,0,0,0);
  let diff = (target - d.getDay() + 7) % 7;
  if(diff === 0) diff = 7;
  d.setDate(d.getDate() + diff);
  return d;
}
/* Next occurrence of the admin-selected monthly bonus date (or last day of month) */
function lbNextMonthly(now){
  const day = lbMonthlyDay();
  const build = (year, monthIndex) => {
    const lastDate = new Date(year, monthIndex + 1, 0).getDate();
    const dayOfMonth = day === "last" ? lastDate : Math.min(day, lastDate);
    return new Date(year, monthIndex, dayOfMonth, 0, 0, 0, 0);
  };
  let target = build(now.getFullYear(), now.getMonth());
  if(now.getTime() >= target.getTime()) target = build(now.getFullYear(), now.getMonth() + 1);
  return target;
}
function lbFormatLeft(ms){
  if(ms < 0) ms = 0;
  const total = Math.floor(ms / 1000);
  const d = Math.floor(total / 86400);
  const h = Math.floor((total % 86400) / 3600);
  const m = Math.floor((total % 3600) / 60);
  const s = total % 60;
  const p = n => String(n).padStart(2,"0");
  return (d > 0 ? d + "d " : "") + p(h) + "h " + p(m) + "m " + p(s) + "s";
}
let lbCountdownTimer = null;
function lbRenderCountdown(){
  const wVal = document.getElementById("lbWeeklyCountdown");
  const mVal = document.getElementById("lbMonthlyCountdown");
  const wCard = document.getElementById("lbWeeklyTimer");
  const mCard = document.getElementById("lbMonthlyTimer");
  const wSub = document.getElementById("lbWeeklySub");
  const mSub = document.getElementById("lbMonthlySub");
  const note = document.getElementById("lbResetNote");
  if(!wVal || !mVal) return;

  if(!settings.leaderboardEnabled){
    wCard.classList.add("paused");
    mCard.classList.add("paused");
    wVal.textContent = "Paused";
    mVal.textContent = "Paused";
    wSub.textContent = "Bonuses are off";
    mSub.textContent = "Bonuses are off";
    if(note) note.classList.add("hidden");
    return;
  }
  wCard.classList.remove("paused");
  mCard.classList.remove("paused");

  const now = new Date();
  const w = lbNextWeekly(now);
  const m = lbNextMonthly(now);
  const fmt = { day:"numeric", month:"short" };
  wVal.textContent = lbFormatLeft(w.getTime() - now.getTime());
  mVal.textContent = lbFormatLeft(m.getTime() - now.getTime());
  wSub.textContent = LB_DAY_NAMES[lbWeeklyDay()] + ", " + w.toLocaleDateString("en-IN", fmt);
  mSub.textContent = (lbMonthlyDay() === "last" ? "Last day, " : "") + m.toLocaleDateString("en-IN", fmt);

  if(note){
    const reset = lbResetAt();
    const fresh = reset && (reset > lbWeekStart(now).getTime() || reset > lbMonthStart(now).getTime());
    if(fresh){
      note.textContent = "Leaderboard was reset on " + new Date(reset).toLocaleDateString("en-IN", { day:"numeric", month:"short" }) + ". Counting and bonuses start fresh from the next cycle.";
      note.classList.remove("hidden");
    }else note.classList.add("hidden");
  }
}
function startLbCountdown(){
  lbRenderCountdown();
  if(lbCountdownTimer) clearInterval(lbCountdownTimer);
  lbCountdownTimer = setInterval(lbRenderCountdown, 1000);
}

function tmLeft(ms){
  let s = Math.max(0, Math.floor(ms/1000));
  const d = Math.floor(s/86400); s -= d*86400;
  const h = Math.floor(s/3600); s -= h*3600;
  const m = Math.floor(s/60); s -= m*60;
  const pad = n => String(n).padStart(2,"0");
  return (d > 0 ? d + "d " : "") + pad(h) + ":" + pad(m) + ":" + pad(s);
}

function getTournamentState(t){
  const now = Date.now();
  const status = String(t.status || "Upcoming");
  if(["cancel match","cancelled","canceled"].includes(status.toLowerCase().trim())) return "cancelmatch";
  if(status === "Completed") return "complete";
  const startTime = t.registrationEnd ? new Date(t.registrationEnd).getTime() : 0;
  const endTime = t.matchEnding ? new Date(t.matchEnding).getTime() : 0;
  if(endTime && !isNaN(endTime) && now >= endTime) return "endmatch";
  if(startTime && !isNaN(startTime) && now < startTime) return "upcoming";
  return "open"; // joinable
}

/* Closed / turned-OFF matches must never appear in the User Panel tournament list. */
function isTournamentVisible(t){
  const status = String(t.status || "").toLowerCase().trim();
  const matchStatus = String(t.matchStatus || "").toLowerCase().trim();
  // A cancelled match must remain visible even if cancellation also turns the match off.
  if(status === "cancel match" || status === "cancelled" || status === "canceled") return true;
  // Admin "Match OFF (Closed)" toggle -> completely hidden from the User Panel
  if(t.matchOpen === false || t.matchOpen === "false") return false;
  // Closed / turned-OFF / inactive matches never render
  if(status === "closed" || status === "match closed" || status === "off" || status === "inactive") return false;
  if(matchStatus === "closed" || matchStatus === "off" || matchStatus === "inactive") return false;
  if(t.active === false || t.isActive === false || t.matchOn === false || t.isMatchOn === false) return false;
  // Automatic hiding: once the admin "Close Match Schedule" time is reached, the card disappears
  const closeAt = t.matchTime ? new Date(t.matchTime).getTime() : 0;
  if(closeAt && !isNaN(closeAt) && Date.now() >= closeAt) return false;
  return true;
}

  out.sort((a,b) => {
    const oa = Number(a.order ?? a.position ?? a.sortOrder ?? 9999);
    const ob = Number(b.order ?? b.position ?? b.sortOrder ?? 9999);
    if(oa !== ob) return oa - ob;
    const ca = (a.createdAt?.seconds ? a.createdAt.seconds*1000 : 0);
    const cb = (b.createdAt?.seconds ? b.createdAt.seconds*1000 : 0);
    if(ca !== cb) return ca - cb;
    return String(a.name||a.title||"").localeCompare(String(b.name||b.title||""));
  });
  return out;
}

/* A newly added game category must show up even when it lives in another
   collection name or when one read fails, so every known collection is read
   and the results are merged instead of trusting a single source. */
async function fetchAllCategories(){
  const found = [];
  for(const name of CATEGORY_COLLECTIONS){
    try{
      const snap = await getDocs(collection(db,name));
      snap.forEach(d => found.push({id:d.id, __src:name, ...d.data()}));
    }catch(e){ /* collection missing or not readable - keep going */ }
  }
  return mergeCategoryDocs(found);
}

async function loadCategories(){
  categoriesLoading = true;
  renderCategories();
  try{
    const nextCategories = await fetchAllCategories();
    if(nextCategories.length || categories.length === 0){
      categories = nextCategories;
      writeListCache("tmgameCategoryCache",categories);
    }
  }catch(e){ console.error("Load Categories Error:", e); }
  categoriesLoading = false;
  renderCategories();
}

function normalizedCategoryValue(value){
  if(value && typeof value === "object") value = value.id || value.categoryId || value.name || value.title || "";
  return String(value || "").trim().toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]/g, "");
}
function catTournaments(id){
  const category = categories.find(c => String(c.id) === String(id));
  const categoryKeys = [id, category?.id, category?.name, category?.title, category?.gameName]
    .map(normalizedCategoryValue).filter(Boolean);
  return tournaments.filter(t => {
    const tournamentKeys = [
      t.categoryId, t.gameCategoryId, t.category, t.categoryName,
      t.gameId, t.gameName, t.game, t.gameCategory
    ].map(normalizedCategoryValue).filter(Boolean);
    return isTournamentVisible(t) && categoryKeys.some(key => tournamentKeys.includes(key));
  });
}

async function loadTournaments(){
  tournamentsLoading = true;
  renderCategories();
  try {
    const nextTournaments = [], seenTournamentIds = new Set();
    for(const name of ["tournaments","matches"]){
      try{
        const snap = await getDocs(collection(db,name));
        snap.forEach(d => { if(!seenTournamentIds.has(d.id)){ seenTournamentIds.add(d.id); nextTournaments.push({id:d.id,__src:name,...d.data()}); } });
      }catch(e){}
    }
    tournaments = nextTournaments;
    tournaments.sort((a,b) => {
      const ja = Number(a.joinedCount || Object.keys(a.takenSeats||{}).length || 0);
      const jb = Number(b.joinedCount || Object.keys(b.takenSeats||{}).length || 0);
      if(jb !== ja) return jb - ja;
      const ca = (a.createdAt?.seconds ? a.createdAt.seconds*1000 : tmMs(a.createdAt)) || tmMs(a.registrationEnd) || 0;
      const cb = (b.createdAt?.seconds ? b.createdAt.seconds*1000 : tmMs(b.createdAt)) || tmMs(b.registrationEnd) || 0;
      return cb - ca;
    });
    writeListCache("tmgameTournamentCache",tournaments);
  } catch(e) {
    console.error("Load Tournaments Error:", e);
  } finally {
    tournamentsLoading = false;
  }
  renderTournaments();
  renderCategories();
}

}

    },e=>console.error("Settings live sync error:",e));

}

function startCompetitionListeners(){
  stopCompetitionListeners();
  const liveCategoryDocs = new Map();
  const categoryUnsubs = [];
  const pushCategorySnapshot = (name, snap) => {
    liveCategoryDocs.set(name, snap.docs.map(d => ({id:d.id, __src:name, ...d.data()})));
    const merged = mergeCategoryDocs([].concat(...liveCategoryDocs.values()));
    categories = merged;
    writeListCache("tmgameCategoryCache",categories);
    categoriesLoading = false;
    renderCategories();
    if(currentCategoryId) renderCategoryTournaments();
  };
  CATEGORY_COLLECTIONS.forEach(name => {
    try{
      categoryUnsubs.push(onSnapshot(collection(db,name),
        snap => pushCategorySnapshot(name, snap),
        e => {
          console.error("Categories live sync error ("+name+"):", e);
          /* Live sync failed - fall back to a direct read so new categories still appear. */
          loadCategories();
        }));
    }catch(e){}
  });
  categoriesUnsubscribe = () => categoryUnsubs.forEach(u => { try{ u(); }catch(e){} });
  const tournamentCollections = ["tournaments","matches"];
  const liveTournamentDocs = new Map();
  const tournamentUnsubs = [];
  const pushTournamentSnapshot = (name,snap) => {
    liveTournamentDocs.set(name,snap.docs.map(d=>({id:d.id,__src:name,...d.data()})));
    const merged=[],seen=new Set();
    [].concat(...liveTournamentDocs.values()).forEach(t=>{ if(!seen.has(t.id)){seen.add(t.id);merged.push(t);} });
    tournaments=merged.sort((a,b)=>{
      const ja=Number(a.joinedCount||Object.keys(a.takenSeats||{}).length||0),jb=Number(b.joinedCount||Object.keys(b.takenSeats||{}).length||0);
      if(jb!==ja)return jb-ja;
      const ca=(a.createdAt?.seconds?a.createdAt.seconds*1000:tmMs(a.createdAt))||tmMs(a.registrationEnd)||0;
      const cb=(b.createdAt?.seconds?b.createdAt.seconds*1000:tmMs(b.createdAt))||tmMs(b.registrationEnd)||0;
      return cb-ca;
    });
    writeListCache("tmgameTournamentCache",tournaments);
    tournamentsLoading=false;
    renderTournaments();renderCategories();if(currentCategoryId)renderCategoryTournaments();
  };
  tournamentCollections.forEach(name=>{
    try{tournamentUnsubs.push(onSnapshot(collection(db,name),snap=>pushTournamentSnapshot(name,snap),e=>console.warn("Matches live sync error ("+name+"):",e)));}catch(e){}
  });
  tournamentsUnsubscribe=()=>tournamentUnsubs.forEach(u=>{try{u();}catch(e){}});
}

function renderTournaments(){

    if(tournamentFilter === "free") return type === "free";

function tournamentHTML(t){

  const slots = Number(t.totalSlots || 0);

  const blocked = isUserBlocked() || currentUserData?.canJoinTournaments === false;
  const pendingW = hasPendingWithdrawal || hasPendingDeposit;
  const state = getTournamentState(t);

  let btn = "";
  if(state === "cancelmatch") btn = `<button class="join-btn disabled" disabled style="background:#ef4444;color:#fff">Cancel Match</button>`;
  else if(state === "complete") btn = `<button class="join-btn disabled" disabled style="background:#0f172a;color:#fff">Completed</button>`;
  else if(state === "endmatch") btn = `<button class="join-btn disabled" disabled style="background:#64748b;color:#fff">Ending Match</button>`;
  else if(state === "upcoming") btn = `<button class="join-btn disabled" disabled>Upcoming</button>`;
  else if(blocked) btn = `<button class="join-btn disabled" disabled>🔒 Restricted</button>`;
  else if(pendingW) btn = `<button class="join-btn disabled" disabled>⏳ ${hasPendingDeposit && !hasPendingWithdrawal ? "Deposit" : "Withdrawal"} Pending</button>`;

  const startMs = tmMs(t.registrationEnd);

    cdHTML = `<div class="tm-cancel-tag">\u274C Match Cancelled \u2013 Entry fee refunded to wallet.</div>`;

  return `<div class="tournament-card${state === "cancelmatch" ? " cancelled-card" : ""}">
    ${state === "cancelmatch" ? `<div class="cancel-seal" aria-label="Match cancelled">MATCH CANCELLED</div>` : ""}
    ${t.imageUrl ? `<img class="tournament-banner" src="${esc(t.imageUrl)}" onerror="this.style.display='none'">` : ""}
    <div class="tournament-body">
      <div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:flex-start;gap:8px">
        <div class="tournament-name">${esc(t.name||"Tournament")}${type==="free"?`<span class="subscription-dot ${hasUsableSubscription()?"active":""}" title="${hasUsableSubscription()?"Subscription active":"Subscription required"}"></span>`:""}</div>
        <div class="badge ${type==="paid"?"badge-paid":"badge-free"}">${type==="paid"?"PAID":"FREE"}</div>
      </div>
      <div style="margin-top:4px;color:#64748b;font-size:13px">${esc(t.gameName||t.game||"-")}</div>
      <div class="info-grid">
        <div class="info-box"><div class="info-label">Mode</div><div class="info-value">${esc(t.mode||"-")}</div></div>
        <div class="info-box"><div class="info-label">Entry</div><div class="info-value">${type==="paid"?money(t.entryFee):"Free"}</div></div>
        <div class="info-box"><div class="info-label">Prize</div><div class="info-value">${money(t.prize)}</div></div>
        <div class="info-box"><div class="info-label">Slots</div><div class="info-value">${joined}/${slots||"∞"}</div></div>
      </div>
      ${t.prizeDistribution ? `<div style="margin-top:8px;padding:9px 12px;border-radius:12px;background:#fffbeb;border:1px solid #fde68a;font-size:12px;color:#92400e;white-space:pre-line"><b>🏆 Prize Distribution</b><br>${esc(t.prizeDistribution)}</div>` : ""}

window.selectSeat = function(num){
  const t = tournaments.find(x => x.id === selectedTournamentId);
  if(!t) return;
  const taken = t.takenSeats || {};
  if(taken[String(num)] && taken[String(num)] !== currentUser.uid) return;

  selectedSeat = num;
  document.querySelectorAll(".seat").forEach(el => {
    el.classList.remove("selected");
    if(Number(el.dataset.seat) === num) el.classList.add("selected");
  });
  const btn = document.getElementById("joinWithSeatBtn");
  if(btn){ btn.disabled = false; btn.textContent = `Join with Seat #${num}`; }
};

window.startJoinProcess = function(){
  if(isUserBlocked()){ showToast("Your account is blocked"); return; }
  const t = tournaments.find(x => x.id === selectedTournamentId);
  if(!t) return;
  if(hasPendingWithdrawal || hasPendingDeposit){
    showToast(hasPendingDeposit && !hasPendingWithdrawal ? "Cannot join while a deposit is pending" : "Cannot join while a withdrawal is pending");
    return;
  }
  const type = String(t.entryType||"Free").toLowerCase();
  if(type==="free" && !hasUsableSubscription()){ window.closeTournamentModal(); showToast("An active subscription is required"); return window.openPage("subscription"); }
  const fee = type === "paid" ? Number(t.entryFee||0) : 0;

  if(t.totalSlots > 0 && !selectedSeat){ showToast("Please select a seat"); return; }

    return;
  }
  const type = String(t.entryType||"Free").toLowerCase();
  const fee = type === "paid" ? Number(t.entryFee||0) : 0;
  const seat = selectedSeat;
  const gamingId = (document.getElementById("joinGamingId")?.value || "").trim();

  if(!gamingId){

    await runTransaction(db, async (transaction) => {
      const userRef = doc(db,"users", currentUser.uid);
      const tRef = doc(db,"tournaments", selectedTournamentId);

      const tSnap = await transaction.get(tRef);

      if(user.canJoinTournaments === false) throw new Error("Joining restricted");

      const bal = Number(user.walletBalance||0);
      if(fee > 0 && bal < fee) throw new Error("Insufficient balance");

      const taken = tourney.takenSeats || {};
      if(seat && taken[String(seat)]) throw new Error("Seat already taken");

      const newBalance = bal - fee;
      const newTaken = {...taken};
      if(seat) newTaken[String(seat)] = currentUser.uid;

      const partRef = doc(collection(db,"tournamentParticipants"));
      transaction.set(partRef, {

        userId: currentUser.uid,
        userEmail: currentUser.email || "",
        userName: user.name || "User",
        gamingId: gamingId,
        entryFee: fee,
        seatNumber: seat || null,
        status: "joined",
        joinedAt: serverTimestamp()
      });

      transaction.update(tRef, {
        takenSeats: newTaken,
        joinedCount: Number(tourney.joinedCount||0) + 1
      });

      if(fee > 0){
        transaction.update(userRef, { walletBalance: newBalance });
      }
    });

    if(fee > 0){
      await addDoc(collection(db,"walletTransactions"), {
        userId: currentUser.uid,
        type: "tournament_entry",
        amount: -fee,
        reason: `Joined ${t.name}`,
        createdAt: serverTimestamp()
      });
    }

    document.getElementById("joinConfirmModal")?.classList.remove("processing");

    ]);
