/* Duplicate deposit auto-cleanup: same user, Pending, within 15s -> keep earliest only */
let __depCleanupRunning = false;
async function cleanupDuplicateDeposits(list){
  if(__depCleanupRunning) return new Set();
  const ms = x => x.createdAt?.toMillis ? x.createdAt.toMillis() : (x.createdAt?.seconds ? x.createdAt.seconds*1000 : 0);
  const pend = list.filter(x => String(x.status||"Pending")==="Pending" && ms(x)).sort((a,b)=>ms(a)-ms(b));
  const extra = new Set(); let keep = null;
  for(const d of pend){ if(keep && ms(d)-ms(keep) <= 15000){ extra.add(d.id); } else { keep = d; } }
  if(!extra.size) return extra;
  __depCleanupRunning = true;
  try{
    for(const id of extra){
      try{ await runTransaction(db, async t=>{ const r=doc(db,"deposits",id); const sn=await t.get(r); if(sn.exists() && String(sn.data().status||"Pending")==="Pending") t.delete(r); }); }
      catch(e){ console.warn("dup deposit cleanup failed", id, e); }
    }
  } finally { __depCleanupRunning = false; }
  return extra;
}

/* ===== Duplicate pending-withdrawal auto-cleanup (keep earliest, refund extras) ===== */
const WD_DUP_WINDOW_MS = 15000;
function __wdTs(w){ const c=w&&w.createdAt; if(!c) return 0; if(typeof c.toMillis==="function") return c.toMillis(); if(c.seconds!=null) return c.seconds*1000+Math.floor((c.nanoseconds||0)/1e6); const n=Number(new Date(c)); return isNaN(n)?0:n; }
function findDuplicatePendingWithdrawals(list){
  const byUser = {};
  (list||[]).forEach(w=>{ if(String(w.status||"Pending")!=="Pending" || !w.userId) return; (byUser[w.userId]=byUser[w.userId]||[]).push(w); });
  const dups = [];
  Object.values(byUser).forEach(arr=>{
    if(arr.length<2) return;
    arr.sort((a,b)=>__wdTs(a)-__wdTs(b));
    let anchor = arr[0];
    for(let i=1;i<arr.length;i++){
      const w = arr[i];
      if(__wdTs(w)-__wdTs(anchor) <= WD_DUP_WINDOW_MS) dups.push(w); else anchor = w;
    }
  });
  return dups;
}
let __wdCleanupRunning = false;
async function cleanupDuplicateWithdrawals(list){
  if(__wdCleanupRunning) return 0;
  const dups = findDuplicatePendingWithdrawals(list);
  if(!dups.length) return 0;
  __wdCleanupRunning = true;
  let removed = 0;
  try{
    for(const w of dups){
      try{
        await runTransaction(db, async (t)=>{
          const wRef = doc(db,"withdrawals",w.id);
          const wSnap = await t.get(wRef);
          if(!wSnap.exists()) return;
          const d = wSnap.data();
          if(String(d.status||"Pending")!=="Pending") return;
          const uRef = doc(db,"users",d.userId);
          const uSnap = await t.get(uRef);
          if(uSnap.exists() && (d.balanceDeducted || d.fundsHeld)){
            t.update(uRef, { winningBalance: Number(uSnap.data().winningBalance||0) + Number(d.amount||0) });
          }
          t.delete(wRef);
          removed++;
        });
        try{ await addDoc(collection(db,"walletTransactions"), { userId:w.userId, type:"withdrawal_refund", amount:Number(w.amount||0), reason:"Duplicate withdrawal request auto-removed & refunded", createdAt:serverTimestamp() }); }catch(e){}
      }catch(e){ console.warn("dup withdrawal cleanup failed", w.id, e); }
    }
  } finally { __wdCleanupRunning = false; }
  return removed;
}

/* ========== COUNTDOWN (ROOM REVEAL) ========== */
function countdownHTML(revealAt){
  if(!revealAt || isNaN(revealAt)){
    return `<div class="notice" style="margin-top:10px">Room details will be available later</div>`;
  }
  return `<div class="countdown-box" data-reveal="${revealAt}">
    <div class="cd-label">🔒 Room ID & Password unlock in</div>
    <div class="cd-timer">
      <div class="cd-unit"><div class="cd-num" data-cd="d">00</div><div class="cd-cap">Days</div></div>
      <div class="cd-unit"><div class="cd-num" data-cd="h">00</div><div class="cd-cap">Hours</div></div>
      <div class="cd-unit"><div class="cd-num" data-cd="m">00</div><div class="cd-cap">Mins</div></div>
      <div class="cd-unit"><div class="cd-num" data-cd="s">00</div><div class="cd-cap">Secs</div></div>
    </div>
  </div>`;
}

let countdownTimer = null;
function startCountdowns(){
  if(countdownTimer){ clearTimeout(countdownTimer); countdownTimer = null; }
  const loop = () => {
    tickCountdowns();
    // align every tick to the real second boundary so the timer never lags or skips
    countdownTimer = setTimeout(loop, 1000 - (Date.now() % 1000));
  };
  loop();
}
function tickCountdowns(){
  const boxes = document.querySelectorAll(".countdown-box[data-reveal]");
  if(!boxes.length) return;
  const now = Date.now();
  let expired = false;
  const pad = n => String(n).padStart(2,"0");
  boxes.forEach(box => {
    const diff = Number(box.dataset.reveal) - now;
    if(diff <= 0){
      expired = true;
      box.innerHTML = `<div class="cd-label">🔓 Unlocking room details…</div>`;
      box.removeAttribute("data-reveal");
      return;
    }
    const sec = Math.ceil(diff/1000);
    const set = (k,v) => {
      const el = box.querySelector(`[data-cd="${k}"]`);
      if(!el) return;
      const txt = pad(v);
      if(el.textContent !== txt) el.textContent = txt; // only touch the DOM when the digit changes
    };
    set("d", Math.floor(sec/86400));
    set("h", Math.floor(sec%86400/3600));
    set("m", Math.floor(sec%3600/60));
    set("s", sec%60);
  });
  if(expired) setTimeout(() => loadMatches(), 1500);
}

/* ========== SUPPORT ========== */
function supportDailyLimit(){ const n = Number(settings.supportDailyLimit); return Number.isFinite(n) && n > 0 ? n : 3; }
function toMinutes(v){ const m = /^(\d{1,2}):(\d{2})$/.exec(String(v||"")); return m ? (Number(m[1])*60 + Number(m[2])) : null; }
function isSupportWindowOpen(){
  if(settings.supportScheduleEnabled !== true) return true;
  const from = toMinutes(settings.supportStartTime), to = toMinutes(settings.supportEndTime);
  if(from == null || to == null) return true;
  const now = new Date(); const cur = now.getHours()*60 + now.getMinutes();
  return from <= to ? (cur >= from && cur <= to) : (cur >= from || cur <= to);
}
function fmtTime(v){
  const m = toMinutes(v); if(m == null) return v || "";
  const h = Math.floor(m/60), mi = String(m%60).padStart(2,"0");
  const ap = h >= 12 ? "PM" : "AM"; const h12 = h % 12 === 0 ? 12 : h % 12;
  return h12 + ":" + mi + " " + ap;
}
function supportScheduleMessage(){
  return settings.supportOffMessage
    || ("Customer Care is open only between " + fmtTime(settings.supportStartTime) + " and " + fmtTime(settings.supportEndTime) + ". Please come back during that time.");
}
function renderSupportSchedule(){
  const box = document.getElementById("supportScheduleBox");
  if(!box) return;
  const open = isSupportWindowOpen();
  const limit = supportDailyLimit();
  if(settings.supportScheduleEnabled === true){
    box.classList.remove("hidden");
    box.innerHTML = (open ? "\u2705 Customer Care is open now" : "\u23f0 Customer Care is closed right now")
      + "<br><b>Timing:</b> " + fmtTime(settings.supportStartTime) + " \u2013 " + fmtTime(settings.supportEndTime)
      + "<br><b>Daily limit:</b> " + limit + " ticket(s) per day";
    box.style.background = open ? "#effaf3" : "#fff4f5";
    box.style.color = open ? "#1a7a4c" : "#b52d43";
  } else {
    box.classList.remove("hidden");
    box.innerHTML = "\u2705 Customer Care is open 24 hours<br><b>Daily limit:</b> " + limit + " ticket(s) per day";
    box.style.background = "#effaf3"; box.style.color = "#1a7a4c";
  }
}
window.renderSupportSchedule = renderSupportSchedule;
window.submitSupportTicket = async function(){
  const subject = document.getElementById("supportSubject").value.trim();
  const message = document.getElementById("supportMessage").value.trim();
  if(isSupportBlocked()){ showSupportBlockedNotice(); return; }
  if(!subject || !message){ showToast("Fill subject and message"); return; }
  if(!isSupportWindowOpen()){ showToast(supportScheduleMessage()); return; }
  const dailyLimit = supportDailyLimit();
  try{
    const mySnap = await getDocs(query(collection(db,"supportTickets"), where("userId","==",currentUser.uid)));
    const myTickets = mySnap.docs.map(d => d.data());
    const openTicket = myTickets.find(t => (t.status||"Pending") !== "Closed" && (t.status||"") !== "Resolved");
    if(openTicket){ showToast("You already have an open ticket. Wait until it is closed."); return; }
    const dayStart = new Date(); dayStart.setHours(0,0,0,0);
    const todayCount = myTickets.filter(t => (t.createdAt?.seconds||0) * 1000 >= dayStart.getTime()).length;
    if(todayCount >= dailyLimit){ showToast("Daily limit reached: only " + dailyLimit + " ticket(s) per day. Try again after 12:00 AM."); return; }
  }catch(e){}
  await addDoc(collection(db,"supportTickets"), {
    userId: currentUser.uid, userName: currentUserData?.name||"", userEmail: currentUser.email||"",
    subject, message, status: "Pending", replies: [], createdAt: serverTimestamp()
  });
  document.getElementById("supportSubject").value = "";
  document.getElementById("supportMessage").value = "";
  showToast("Ticket submitted");
  loadSupportHistory();
};

window.copyProfileField = function(id, label){
  const el = document.getElementById(id);
  const value = (el?.textContent || "").trim();
  if(!value || value === "-"){ showToast("Nothing to copy"); return; }
  const done = () => showToast((label || "Value") + " copied!");
  if(navigator.clipboard?.writeText){
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(value).then(done).catch(() => fallbackCopy(value, done));
  } else {
    fallbackCopy(value, done);
  }
};
function fallbackCopy(value, done){
  try{
    const ta = document.createElement("textarea");
    ta.value = value;
    ta.setAttribute("readonly","");
    ta.style.position = "fixed";
    ta.style.opacity = "0";
    document.body.appendChild(ta);
    ta.select();
    document.execCommand("copy");
    document.body.removeChild(ta);
    done();
  }catch(e){ showToast(value); }
}

/* ========== PULL-TO-REFRESH GESTURE ========== */
(function(){
  const ptr = document.getElementById("ptrIndicator");
  if(!ptr) return;
  const THRESHOLD = 72, MAX_PULL = 104;
  let startY = 0, lastY = 0, pulling = false, frame = 0;

  function drawPull(){
    frame = 0;
    const distance = Math.max(0,lastY - startY);
    const pull = Math.min(MAX_PULL,distance * .48);
    ptr.style.setProperty("--ptr-y",(pull - 58) + "px");
    ptr.style.setProperty("--ptr-rotation",Math.min(300,distance * 2.4) + "deg");
    ptr.classList.toggle("visible",distance > 4);
  }

  function retract(){
    if(frame){ cancelAnimationFrame(frame); frame = 0; }
    ptr.classList.remove("dragging","spinning");
    ptr.classList.add("retracting");
    ptr.style.setProperty("--ptr-y","-64px");
    window.setTimeout(function(){
      if(ptr.dataset.busy !== "1"){
        ptr.classList.remove("visible","retracting");
        ptr.style.removeProperty("--ptr-rotation");
      }
    },320);
  }

  window.addEventListener("touchstart",function(e){
    if(document.getElementById("app").classList.contains("hidden")) return;
    if(ptr.dataset.busy === "1" || e.touches.length !== 1 || window.scrollY > 0) return;
    if(e.target && e.target.closest && e.target.closest(".modal,.ld-modal,.transfer-sheet,.swipe-track,#swipeThumb,input,textarea")) return;
    if(document.querySelector(".modal:not(.hidden),.ld-modal:not(.hidden)")) return;
    startY = lastY = e.touches[0].clientY;
    pulling = true;
    ptr.classList.remove("retracting");
    ptr.classList.add("dragging");
  },{passive:true});

  window.addEventListener("touchmove",function(e){
    if(!pulling || e.touches.length !== 1) return;
    lastY = e.touches[0].clientY;
    const distance = lastY - startY;
    if(distance <= 0 || window.scrollY > 0){
      pulling = false;
      retract();
      return;
    }
    if(e.cancelable) e.preventDefault();
    if(!frame) frame = requestAnimationFrame(drawPull);
  },{passive:false});

  window.addEventListener("touchend",function(e){
    if(!pulling) return;
    pulling = false;
    if(frame){ cancelAnimationFrame(frame); frame = 0; drawPull(); }
    const endY = e.changedTouches && e.changedTouches[0] ? e.changedTouches[0].clientY : lastY;
    ptr.classList.remove("dragging");
    if(endY - startY >= THRESHOLD && window.scrollY <= 0){
      ptr.classList.add("visible","spinning");
      ptr.style.setProperty("--ptr-y","8px");
      window.refreshAllData();
    }else{
      retract();
    }
  },{passive:true});

  window.addEventListener("touchcancel",function(){
    if(!pulling) return;
    pulling = false;
    retract();
  },{passive:true});
})();

/* ========== AUTOMATED LEADERBOARD BONUSES ========== */
function isLastDayOfMonth(d){
  const n = new Date(d.getTime());
  n.setDate(n.getDate() + 1);
  return n.getDate() === 1;
}
async function getRankedReferrers(){
  const snap = await getDocs(collection(db,"users"));
  const users = snap.docs.map(d => ({ id:d.id, ...d.data() }));
  const counts = lbCountReferrals(users);
  return users
    .map(u => ({ id:u.id, name:u.name || (u.email||"User").split("@")[0], count: counts[u.id] || 0 }))
    .filter(u => u.count > 0)
    .sort((a,b) => b.count - a.count || String(a.name).localeCompare(String(b.name)));
}
async function creditLeaderboardBonus(kind, periodKey, amount, rank){
  const userRef = doc(db,"users", currentUser.uid);
  const field = kind === "weekly" ? "weeklyBonusPeriod" : "monthlyBonusPeriod";
  let credited = false;
  await runTransaction(db, async (tx) => {
    const snap = await tx.get(userRef);
    if(!snap.exists()) return;
    const u = snap.data();
    if(String(u[field] || "") === periodKey) return;
    tx.update(userRef, {
      winningBalance: Number(u.winningBalance||0) + amount,
      [field]: periodKey
    });
    credited = true;
  });
  if(credited){
    try{
      await addDoc(collection(db,"walletTransactions"), {
        userId: currentUser.uid,
        type: kind === "weekly" ? "weekly_leaderboard_bonus" : "monthly_leaderboard_bonus",
        amount,
        reason: `${kind === "weekly" ? "Weekly" : "Monthly"} leaderboard bonus (Rank ${rank})`,
        createdAt: serverTimestamp()
      });
    }catch(e){}
    await loadUser();
    showToast(`${kind === "weekly" ? "Weekly" : "Monthly"} leaderboard bonus ${money(amount)} credited!`);
  }
}
async function autoCreditLeaderboardBonuses(){
  try{
    /* Leaderboard OFF from admin panel => never credit any bonus */
    if(!currentUser || !settings.leaderboardEnabled) return;
    const now = new Date();
    const resetMs = lbResetAt();
    const isSunday = now.getDay() === 0;
    const isMonthEnd = isLastDayOfMonth(now);
    if(!isSunday && !isMonthEnd) return;

    const ranked = await getRankedReferrers();
    const myIndex = ranked.findIndex(u => u.id === currentUser.uid);
    if(myIndex !== 0 && myIndex !== 1) return;
    const amount = Number(myIndex === 0 ? settings.rank1Bonus : settings.rank2Bonus);
    if(!(amount > 0)) return;
    const rank = myIndex + 1;

    /* After a reset the current cycle starts fresh: no bonus for a cycle
       that was already running when the leaderboard was switched back ON. */
    if(isSunday && !(resetMs && resetMs > lbWeekStart(now).getTime())){
      const weekKey = `${now.getFullYear()}-${String(now.getMonth()+1).padStart(2,"0")}-${String(now.getDate()).padStart(2,"0")}`;
      await creditLeaderboardBonus("weekly", weekKey, amount, rank);
    }
    if(isMonthEnd && !(resetMs && resetMs > lbMonthStart(now).getTime())){
      const monthKey = `${now.getFullYear()}-${String(now.getMonth()+1).padStart(2,"0")}`;
      await creditLeaderboardBonus("monthly", monthKey, amount, rank);
    }
  }catch(e){ console.error("Leaderboard bonus error:", e); }
}

(function(){
  const rawOpenPage = window.openPage;
  let tmSkipPush = false;
  window.openPage = async function(page){
    const result = await rawOpenPage(page);
    if(!tmSkipPush){
      try{
        const cur = history.state && history.state.tmPage;
        if(cur !== page) history.pushState({tmPage:page}, "", location.href);
      }catch(e){}
    }
    return result;
  };
  try{ history.replaceState({tmPage:"home"}, "", location.href); }catch(e){}
  window.addEventListener("popstate", function(ev){
    const page = (ev.state && ev.state.tmPage) || "home";
    tmSkipPush = true;
    Promise.resolve(window.openPage(page)).catch(()=>{}).then(()=>{ tmSkipPush = false; });
    if(page === "home"){
      try{ history.pushState({tmPage:"home"}, "", location.href); }catch(e){}
    }
  });
  // Android system back button (Cordova/Capacitor WebView): always route to Home
  // so returning from an external action never leaves a blank/loading screen.
  document.addEventListener("backbutton", function(ev){
    try{ if(ev && ev.preventDefault) ev.preventDefault(); }catch(e){}

    const nextIndex = (index + items.length) % items.length;

    try{
      if(native){ window.open(url,"_system","noopener,noreferrer"); return true; }
      const w=window.open(url,"_blank","noopener,noreferrer");
      if(!w) window.location.assign(url);
      return true;
    }catch(e){ window.location.assign(url); return true; }

    }

        window.location.href="intent://resolve?domain="+encodeURIComponent(path.split("/")[0])+"#Intent;scheme=tg;package=org.telegram.messenger;S.browser_fallback_url="+encodeURIComponent(raw)+";end";

      return void openExternal(raw);
    }
    if(!native && /Android/i.test(navigator.userAgent) && /; wv\)|Version\/\d+.*Chrome/i.test(navigator.userAgent)){
      window.location.href="intent://"+u.host+u.pathname+u.search+u.hash+"#Intent;scheme="+u.protocol.replace(":","")+";package=com.android.chrome;S.browser_fallback_url="+encodeURIComponent(raw)+";end";
      return;
    }
    openExternal(raw);
  }catch(e){ window.location.assign(raw); }

/* ================= LUCKY DRAW (USER PANEL) ================= */
let luckyDraws = [];
let luckyTickets = [];
let luckyTicketsUnsub = null;
let luckyTimerInt = null;
let luckySelectedDraw = null;
const LD_SEEN_KEY = "tmLuckySeen";

function ldMs(v){
  if(!v) return 0;
  if(typeof v === "number") return v;
  if(typeof v === "object" && v.seconds) return v.seconds * 1000;
  const t = Date.parse(v);
  return isNaN(t) ? 0 : t;
}
function ldPrizeList(d){ return (Array.isArray(d?.prizes) ? d.prizes : []).map(x => Number(x||0)).filter(x => x > 0); }
function ldPrizeTotal(d){ return ldPrizeList(d).reduce((s,x) => s + x, 0); }
function ldDateText(ms){
  if(!ms) return "—";
  try{ return new Date(ms).toLocaleString("en-IN",{day:"2-digit",month:"short",hour:"2-digit",minute:"2-digit"}); }
  catch(e){ return "—"; }
}
function ldCountdown(ms){
  const left = ms - Date.now();
  if(left <= 0) return "Closed";
  const d = Math.floor(left/86400000), h = Math.floor(left%86400000/3600000),
        m = Math.floor(left%3600000/60000), s = Math.floor(left%60000/1000);
  const pad = n => String(n).padStart(2,"0");
  return (d > 0 ? d + "d " : "") + pad(h) + ":" + pad(m) + ":" + pad(s);
}

async function loadLuckyDraws(){
  try{
    const snap = await getDocs(collection(db,"luckyDraws"));
    luckyDraws = [];
    snap.forEach(d => luckyDraws.push({ id:d.id, ...d.data() }));
    luckyDraws.sort((a,b) => (ldMs(b.createdAt) || ldMs(b.startAt) || ldMs(b.closeAt)) - (ldMs(a.createdAt) || ldMs(a.startAt) || ldMs(a.closeAt)));
  }catch(e){ luckyDraws = []; }
}

let luckyTicketsUid = null;
async function loadLuckyTicketsOnce(){
  if(!currentUser) return;
  try{
    const snap = await getDocs(query(collection(db,"luckyTickets"), where("uid","==",currentUser.uid)));
    luckyTickets = [];
    snap.forEach(d => luckyTickets.push({ id:d.id, ...d.data() }));
    luckyTickets.sort((a,b) => ldMs(b.createdAt) - ldMs(a.createdAt));
  }catch(e){ console.warn("Lucky tickets load:", e); }
}
function watchLuckyTickets(){
  if(!currentUser) return;
  if(luckyTicketsUnsub && luckyTicketsUid !== currentUser.uid){ try{ luckyTicketsUnsub(); }catch(e){} luckyTicketsUnsub = null; }
  if(luckyTicketsUnsub) return;
  luckyTicketsUid = currentUser.uid;
  try{
    luckyTicketsUnsub = onSnapshot(
      query(collection(db,"luckyTickets"), where("uid","==",currentUser.uid)),
      snap => {
        luckyTickets = [];
        snap.forEach(d => luckyTickets.push({ id:d.id, ...d.data() }));
        luckyTickets.sort((a,b) => ldMs(b.createdAt) - ldMs(a.createdAt));
        updateLuckyDot();
        renderLuckyTickets();
        renderLuckyDraws();
        const win = luckyTickets.find(t => t.status === "won" && !t.celebrationSeen);
        if(win) showLuckyWinner(win);
      },
      (err) => { console.warn("Lucky ticket listener:", err); luckyTicketsUnsub = null; loadLuckyTicketsOnce().then(()=>{ updateLuckyDot(); renderLuckyTickets(); renderLuckyDraws(); }); }
    );
  }catch(e){}
}

function ldSeenSignature(){
  return luckyTickets.map(t => t.id + ":" + (t.status||"joined") + ":" + Number(t.winAmount||0)).join("|");
}
function updateLuckyDot(){
  const dot = document.getElementById("ldTicketDot");
  if(!dot) return;
  const sig = ldSeenSignature();
  let seen = "";
  try{ seen = localStorage.getItem(LD_SEEN_KEY) || ""; }catch(e){}
  if(luckyTickets.length && sig !== seen) dot.classList.remove("hidden");
  else dot.classList.add("hidden");
}
function clearLuckyDot(){
  try{ localStorage.setItem(LD_SEEN_KEY, ldSeenSignature()); }catch(e){}
  document.getElementById("ldTicketDot")?.classList.add("hidden");
}

"start" : "end"}" data-ld-start="${startMs}" data-ld-close="${closeMs}"`}>${closed ? "Closed" : notStarted ? ldCountdown(startMs) : closeMs ? ldCountdown(closeMs) : "Open"}</b></div>

          : `<div class="ld-winbar locked"><span class="ld-winbar-ico">🔒</span> Winners unlock after close</div>`}

function renderLuckyTickets(){
  const box = document.getElementById("ldTicketList");
  if(!box) return;
  if(!luckyTickets.length){
    box.innerHTML = `<div class="ld-empty">🎫 You have no Lucky Draw tickets yet.</div>`;
    return;
  }
  box.innerHTML = luckyTickets.map(t => {
    const status = t.status || "joined";
    const closeMs = ldMs(t.closeAt);
    const cls = status === "won" ? " won" : status === "lost" ? " lost" : "";
    const badge = status === "won"
      ? `<span class="ld-badge win">🏆 Winner ${money(t.winAmount)}</span>`
      : status === "lost"
        ? `<span class="ld-badge loss">🛡️ Next Time Better Luck</span>`
        : `<span class="ld-badge live">● Live</span>`;
    const timer = status === "joined" && closeMs
      ? `<span>Closes in <b class="ld-timer" data-ld-close="${closeMs}">${ldCountdown(closeMs)}</b></span>`
      : `<span>${status === "won" ? "Prize credited to Winning Balance" : status === "lost" ? "Result declared" : "Result awaited"}</span>`;
    return `<div class="ld-ticket${cls}">
      ${status === "won" ? `<span class="ld-shine"></span>` : ""}
      <div class="ld-ticket-top">
        <div class="ld-ticket-name">${esc(t.drawName || "Lucky Draw")}</div>
        ${badge}
      </div>
      <div class="ld-ticket-num">
        <span><small>TICKET NUMBER</small><b>${esc(t.ticket || "----")}</b></span>
        <span style="text-align:right"><small>ENTRY PAID</small><b style="font-size:17px;letter-spacing:0">${money(t.entryFee)}</b></span>
      </div>
      <div class="ld-ticket-foot">${timer}<span>${ldDateText(ldMs(t.createdAt))}</span></div>
    </div>`;
  }).join("");
}

function tickLuckyTimers(){
  let rerender = false;
  const now = Date.now();
  document.querySelectorAll("[data-ld-phase]").forEach(el => {
    const startMs = Number(el.getAttribute("data-ld-start")||0);
    const closeMs = Number(el.getAttribute("data-ld-close")||0);
    const label = el.parentElement?.querySelector("small");
    if(startMs && now < startMs){
      if(label) label.textContent = "STARTING";
      el.dataset.ldPhase = "start";
      el.textContent = ldCountdown(startMs);
    } else if(closeMs && now < closeMs){
      if(label) label.textContent = "ENDING";
      el.dataset.ldPhase = "end";
      el.textContent = ldCountdown(closeMs);
    } else if(closeMs){
      rerender = true;
    } else {
      if(label) label.textContent = "STATUS";
      el.textContent = "Open";
    }
  });
  document.querySelectorAll("[data-ld-state]").forEach(el => {
    const startMs = Number(el.getAttribute("data-ld-start")||0);
    const closeMs = Number(el.getAttribute("data-ld-close")||0);
    el.textContent = closeMs && now >= closeMs ? "Live End" : startMs && now < startMs ? "Upcoming" : "Live now";
    const fill = el.parentElement?.querySelector(".ld-meter-fill");
    if(fill){ fill.classList.toggle("live",(!startMs || now >= startMs) && (!closeMs || now < closeMs)); fill.classList.toggle("done",!!closeMs && now >= closeMs); }
  });
  document.querySelectorAll(".ld-ticket [data-ld-close]").forEach(el => {
    const ms = Number(el.getAttribute("data-ld-close")||0);
    if(ms) el.textContent = ldCountdown(ms);
  });
  if(rerender && document.getElementById("page-luckydraw")?.classList.contains("active")) renderLuckyDraws();
}

  if(hasPendingDeposit || hasPendingWithdrawal){ showToast(hasPendingDeposit && !hasPendingWithdrawal ? "Cannot join Lucky Draw while a deposit is pending" : "Cannot join Lucky Draw while a withdrawal is pending"); return; }
  document.getElementById("ldJoinBody").classList.add("hidden");
  document.getElementById("ldJoinLoading").classList.remove("hidden");
  let ticketNumber = "";
  try{
    await runTransaction(db, async tx => {
      const drawRef = doc(db,"luckyDraws",d.id);
      const ticketRef = doc(db,"luckyTickets", d.id + "_" + currentUser.uid);
      const userRef = doc(db,"users",currentUser.uid);
      const [ds, ts, us] = await Promise.all([tx.get(drawRef), tx.get(ticketRef), tx.get(userRef)]);
      if(!ds.exists()) throw new Error("This match is no longer available");
      if(ts.exists()) throw new Error("You already have a ticket for this match");
      if(!us.exists()) throw new Error("Account unavailable");
      const data = ds.data();
      const closeMs = ldMs(data.closeAt);
      const winnerLimit = Number(data.winnerLimit||0);
      if(data.resultDeclared === true || (winnerLimit > 0 && Number(data.winnersCount||0) >= winnerLimit) || (closeMs && Date.now() >= closeMs)) throw new Error("This match is closed");
      const startMs = ldMs(data.startAt);
      if(startMs && Date.now() < startMs) throw new Error("This match has not started yet");
      const fee = Number(data.entryFee||0);
      const balance = Number(us.data().walletBalance||0);
      if(fee > balance) throw new Error("Insufficient available balance");
      const used = Array.isArray(data.usedTickets) ? data.usedTickets.slice() : [];
      let num = "", guard = 0;
      do{ num = String(Math.floor(1000 + Math.random()*9000)); guard++; }
      while(used.includes(num) && guard < 9000);
      if(used.includes(num)) throw new Error("Tickets sold out for this match");
      used.push(num);
      ticketNumber = num;
      tx.update(userRef, { walletBalance: balance - fee });
      tx.update(drawRef, { usedTickets: used, joinedCount: Number(data.joinedCount||0) + 1 });
      tx.set(ticketRef, {
        drawId: d.id,
        drawName: data.name || "Lucky Draw",
        ticket: num,
        uid: currentUser.uid,
        userName: currentUserData?.name || "User",
        userEmail: currentUserData?.email || "",
        accountNumber: currentUserData?.tmgameAccountNumber || "",
        entryFee: fee,
        prizeTotal: (Array.isArray(data.prizes)?data.prizes:[]).reduce((s,x)=>s+Number(x||0),0),
        closeAt: closeMs,
        status: "joined",
        winAmount: 0,
        celebrationSeen: false,
        createdAt: serverTimestamp()
      });
    });
    /* Ticket booked: show success immediately, refresh in background */
    const localTicket = { id: d.id + "_" + currentUser.uid, drawId: d.id, drawName: d.name || "Lucky Draw", ticket: ticketNumber, uid: currentUser.uid, entryFee: Number(d.entryFee||0), closeAt: ldMs(d.closeAt), status: "joined", winAmount: 0, createdAt: Date.now() };
    if(!luckyTickets.some(t => t.id === localTicket.id)) luckyTickets.unshift(localTicket);
    if(currentUserData){ currentUserData.walletBalance = Math.max(0, Number(currentUserData.walletBalance||0) - Number(d.entryFee||0)); try{ updateUserUI(); }catch(e){} }
    document.getElementById("ldJoinLoading").classList.add("hidden");
    document.getElementById("ldJoinSuccessNum").textContent = "Your ticket number is " + ticketNumber;
    document.getElementById("ldJoinSuccess").classList.remove("hidden");
    showToast("🎟️ Ticket booked successfully!");
    try{ if(navigator.vibrate) navigator.vibrate([30,40,60]); }catch(e){}
    renderLuckyTickets(); renderLuckyDraws(); updateLuckyDot();
    loadUser().catch(()=>{});
    loadLuckyDraws().then(()=>{ renderLuckyDraws(); }).catch(()=>{});
    loadLuckyTicketsOnce().then(()=>{ renderLuckyTickets(); renderLuckyDraws(); updateLuckyDot(); }).catch(()=>{});
  }catch(e){
    document.getElementById("ldJoinLoading").classList.add("hidden");
    document.getElementById("ldJoinBody").classList.remove("hidden");
    showToast(e.message || "Could not buy ticket");
  }
};

function ldFireConfetti(){
  const box = document.getElementById("ldConfetti");
  if(!box) return;
  const colors = ["#f6c343","#ff5ba7","#4f8bff","#22c55e","#ff8a3d","#a855f7"];
  box.innerHTML = "";
  for(let i = 0; i < 90; i++){
    const piece = document.createElement("i");
    piece.style.left = Math.random()*100 + "%";
    piece.style.background = colors[i % colors.length];
    piece.style.animationDuration = (2.2 + Math.random()*1.8) + "s";
    piece.style.animationDelay = (Math.random()*0.7) + "s";
    piece.style.transform = "rotate(" + Math.random()*360 + "deg)";
    box.appendChild(piece);
  }
  box.classList.remove("hidden");
  setTimeout(() => { box.classList.add("hidden"); box.innerHTML = ""; }, 5200);
}

/* ==== TMGame double-tap / double-submit protection ==== */
(function(){
  const BUSY = new Set();

  /* Only blocks a 2nd/3rd tap while the first one is still running.
     It never disables buttons itself, so each action's own button logic keeps working. */
  function makeGuard(name, orig){
    if(typeof orig !== "function" || orig.__tmGuarded) return orig;
    const wrapped = function(){
      /* An older guard that a newer wrapper calls internally just passes through */
      if(window[name] !== wrapped) return orig.apply(this, arguments);
      if(BUSY.has(name)) return;
      BUSY.add(name);
      const release = function(){ BUSY.delete(name); };
      let result;
      try{ result = orig.apply(this, arguments); }
      catch(err){ release(); throw err; }
      if(result && typeof result.then === "function"){ result.then(release, release); }
      else { setTimeout(release, 600); }
      return result;
    };
    try{ Object.keys(orig).forEach(function(k){ wrapped[k] = orig[k]; }); }catch(e){}
    wrapped.__tmGuarded = true;
    wrapped.__tmOriginal = orig;
    return wrapped;
  }

(function(){

  let tick = null;
